sum: This article introduces the Cascadia Region Earthquake Science Center (CRESCENT), established to address the significant seismic, tsunami, and cascading hazard risks in the Pacific Northwest. CRESCENT aims to overcome challenges such as a less mature regional earthquake culture and workforce gaps in community representation and technical training. By integrating scientific research, fostering collaboration, and leveraging new technologies, the center seeks to improve hazard assessment and resilience. The paper outlines a novel regional framework that connects science to practice, promoting equitable workforce development, societal preparedness, and an academic-regional partnership model applicable to other seismically active regions.

sum: This study investigates the coseismic and post-seismic changes in site response associated with the 2011 Mw 9.0 Tohoku-Oki earthquake in northern Honshu, Japan. By applying spectral ratio methods to KiK-net strong-motion data, the authors observe that during peak shaking, the predominant frequency and maximum amplification factor decreased by 20–45% and 55–75%, respectively, due to time-varying nonlinearity. Over the subsequent 12 years (2011–2023), the predominant frequency exhibited a two-stage logarithmic linear recovery. Concurrently, the maximum spectral ratio at lower frequencies grew log-linearly before the predominant frequency recovered. This long-term monitoring provides critical insights into site-response nonlinearity and geotechnical seismic design.

sum: This study presents high-precision Nd isotopic measurements of recently erupted lavas from the submarine Fani Maoré volcano in the Comoros archipelago. The authors report significantly positive 142Nd anomalies, which require the preservation of a light rare-earth element (REE) depleted reservoir formed within the first 100 million years of Earth's history. They suggest this reservoir is composed of Hadean bridgmanite that crystallized from a primordial magma ocean. This discovery challenges the conventional view of a well-mixed modern mantle, suggesting that primordial, unmixed Hadean reservoirs can survive billions of years of mantle convection and plate tectonics to feed present-day hotspot volcanism.
本研究对科摩罗群岛Fani Maoré海底火山新喷发的熔岩进行了高精度钕（Nd）同位素测量。研究发现了显著的正142Nd异常，这表明地幔中保留了在地球历史前1亿年内形成的轻稀土元素亏损物质。作者提出该物质主要由早期地球岩浆洋结晶出的冥古宙桥石组成。这一发现挑战了现代地幔已被充分混合的传统观点，表明原……

sum: This paper presents a distributed source inversion strategy to reconstruct an effective spatio-temporal ultrasound transducer model. Large-aperture transducers often exhibit non-uniform excitation and spatial interference, which complicate wave propagation modeling. The proposed method captures aperture-dependent phase and amplitude variations without requiring internal structural details of the transducer. Validated using directivity measurements on an aluminum half-cylinder, the reconstructed source model yields simulations that closely match experimental wavefields. Synthetic tests on reverse time migration (RTM) and full-waveform inversion (FWI) demonstrate that accurate transducer source modeling is critical for high-fidelity simulation-based imaging and significantly improves reconstruction quality.

sum: This study presents a high-resolution ambient noise tomography of the Dabie Orogenic Belt in China. By extracting surface-wave dispersion curves from ambient noise cross-correlations, the authors construct a detailed 3D shear-wave velocity model of the crust. The resulting velocity structure provides new insights into the deep crustal architecture, the spatial distribution of ultrahigh-pressure metamorphic rocks, and the tectonic evolution associated with the collision between the North China Craton and the Yangtze Craton.
本研究利用背景噪声成像技术，获得了中国大别造山带的高分辨率地壳三维剪切波速度模型。通过提取背景噪声互相关函数中的面波频散曲线，精细刻画了该区域的地壳深部结构。研究结果为理解超高压变质岩的深部空间分布，以及华北克拉通与扬子克拉通碰撞相关的深部动力学和构造演化过程提供了新的约束。

Continuous ambient noise data recorded by a seismic array deployed across the Dabie Orogenic Belt.

sum: This study reveals a simple yet overlooked relationship between earthquake size and fault dip in subduction zones. By analyzing global earthquake statistics, the authors demonstrate that the probability of extreme events peaks on ultralow-angle faults. Through three detailed case studies, they show that earthquakes grow larger when the fault geometry aligns with the regional stress field. The paper discusses how these favorable stress configurations develop along subduction interfaces and highlights the importance of monitoring temporal stress evolution to improve megaearthquake forecasting.
本研究揭示了俯冲带地震震级与断层倾角之间简单却长期被忽视的关系。通过全球地震统计分析，作者发现极端地震事件的发生概率在超低角度断层上达到峰值。结合三个典型案例研究，他们证明当断层几何结构与区域应力场方向一致时，地震破裂更容易扩大。研究探讨了俯冲界面上这种有利应力格局的形成机制，并强调了监测应力随时间……

t: Statistical analysis of global earthquake catalogs combined with stress field alignment modeling and case studies of major subduction events.

Global earthquake statistics and observational data from three subduction zone megaearthquake case studies.

sum: This paper presents a novel elastic multi-parameter full-waveform inversion (FWI) framework that directly models pressure, particle velocity, and gauge-length-averaged DAS strain from a single forward simulation using a velocity-stress-strain (VSS) formulation. This eliminates the need to convert measured strain to particle velocity, avoiding numerical noise and spectral distortion. By injecting data residuals additively into a single backward simulation, the computational cost remains independent of the active sensor subsets. Benchmarked on cross-talk and elastic Marmousi models, the joint inversion of two-component geophones and deviated borehole DAS cables significantly improves elastic parameter recovery and mitigates inter-parameter cross-talk. The implementation is open-sourced as xFWI, a Devito-based Python package.
本文提出了一种新型多参数弹性全波形反演（FWI）框架，采用速度-应力-应变（VSS）公式，在单次前向模拟中直接建模压力、质点速度和标距平均DAS应变。这避免了将应变转换为速度所引入的数值噪声和频谱失真。通过将残差累加注入单次反向传播，计算成本与传感器子集数量无关。在交叉干扰和弹性Marmousi模型……

sum: This study addresses the challenge of high noise levels in citizen-hosted RaspberryShake and temporary seismometers in Haiti. By applying the deep learning denoising algorithm DeepDenoiser, the authors improved the average signal-to-noise ratio by 4.7 dB. While denoising increased false detections for STA/LTA and deep learning detectors, combining DeepDenoiser with template matching significantly enhanced true detections while suppressing false alarms. Applying this workflow, they compiled a high-resolution, 2-year earthquake catalog containing three times more events than the original catalog. The new catalog reveals a highly segmented aftershock distribution for the 2021 Mw 7.2 earthquake, showing a northeast-dipping cluster coinciding with the initial reverse rupture and a western strike-slip cluster. It also highlights potentially fluid-induced offshore swarms in the Jérémie basin and active seismicity beneath Lake Enriquillo.

sum: This study investigates the seismogenic mechanism of the 2024 Feidong earthquake swarm (maximum magnitude M 4.7) in the Hefei segment of the Tanlu fault zone (TLFZ) using 3D magnetotelluric imaging. The imaging reveals a large-scale, Tanlu high-resistivity belt (TLRB) along the fault. The southern segment of this belt acts as a giant, rigid barrier inhibiting dextral strike-slip motion. The earthquake swarm occurred in a structurally weak zone on the western flank of the central TLRB. A local barrier effectively impeded northeastward rupture propagation. Although this barrier shares geometric similarities with seismogenic asperities of stronger earthquakes, low regional tectonic stress and seismic energy release suggest a low risk of strong earthquakes in the near future.
本研究利用三维大地电磁成像技术，探讨了郯庐断裂带合肥段2024年肥东震群（最大震级M 4.7）的孕震机制。成像结果揭示了沿断裂带分布的大规模郯庐高阻带（TLRB）。该高阻带南段作为巨大的刚性屏障，抑制了断裂带的右旋走滑运动。肥东震群发生于高阻带中部西侧的结构薄弱带内，局部屏障体有效阻止了破裂向东北方……

sum: This study evaluates the crustal evolution and relative crustal-thickness variations of Hainan Island and Borneo since the Paleozoic to understand the interaction between the Tethyan and Paleo-Pacific subduction systems. Using new and published zircon U-Pb-Hf isotopes and detrital zircon Eu/Eu* data, the authors identify synchronous intervals of reduced apparent crustal thickness. The Hf isotope signatures suggest a transition to a Tethyan–Paleo-Pacific double-subduction system beneath Sundaland during the Jurassic–Cretaceous for Borneo, while Hainan experienced continued Paleo-Pacific subduction.

sum: This study analyzes the source parameters of thousands of shallow volcano-tectonic earthquakes at Piton de la Fournaise volcano (2014–2023) using coda wave envelopes. By inverting narrow-band coda envelopes, the authors isolate source terms, site effects, and attenuation, computing source spectral ratios to estimate seismic moments and corner frequencies. They find an average stress drop of ~1 MPa and a scaling relation of M0 ∝ fc^-3, consistent with standard tectonic earthquakes. The temporal stability of the coda shape and stress drops over a decade suggests that these events occur on a pre-existing ring-fault system driven by magmatic pressurization, rather than creating new fractures.
本研究利用尾波包络反演方法，分析了富尔奈斯火山2014至2023年间数千个浅层火山构造地震的震源参数。通过窄带滤波尾波包络联合反演，分离了震源项、场地效应和衰减因子，并利用谱比法计算了地震矩和拐角频率。结果表明，多数地震的平均应力降约为1 MPa，且满足M0 ∝ fc^-3的标度关系，与构造地震一致……

sum: This study investigates small-scale faults on the flanks of Piton de la Fournaise volcano by analyzing InSAR data from 30 magma intrusions between 2010 and 2023. By filtering out long-wavelength displacements, the authors reveal 1-3 cm of differential motion, identifying 151 active fault structures. Most (87%) are tensile fractures along the NE-SE rift zone axis activated by intrusion-induced dilation, forming graben-like deflation structures. Additionally, nested circular faults on the northwestern flank represent relict ring-faults from past crater collapses. Integrating prior electromagnetic data, the authors suggest these faults facilitate hydrothermal fluid circulation, leading to rock alteration and edifice weakening. This highlights the utility of high-resolution InSAR in mapping structural weaknesses for volcanic hazard assessment.
本研究通过分析2010至2023年间30次岩浆侵入的InSAR数据，探讨了富尔奈斯火山山体表面的微细断层。通过滤除长波长形变，发现了1-3厘米的局部差分运动，并识别出151个活动断层构造。其中87%为受侵入张裂激活的张性裂隙，沿东北-东南裂谷带分布，形成了地堑状沉降区。此外，西北翼的环状嵌套断层被解……

sum: This study investigates the recurrent seismicity along the Vuache Fault in the French western Alps following the 1996 M5.3 Annecy earthquake. By analyzing post-1996 seismicity and calculating local seismic velocity variations, the authors demonstrate that while the mainshock was tectonic, subsequent seismicity is driven by fluid pressurization in a deep, fractured sedimentary aquifer. The aftershock sequence exhibited a two-phase behavior: an initial random spatial distribution followed by a clear migration phase indicating fluid diffusion. The hydraulic diffusivity of the aquifer was estimated at approximately 2 m²/s from both aftershock migration and the correlation between velocity variations and rainfall. This high diffusivity suggests a highly permeable, confined reservoir within the regional flat-and-ramp structure.
本研究调查了1996年法国安纳西M5.3地震后，阿尔卑斯西部Vuache断层沿线的复发性地震活动。通过分析1996年以来的地震活动并计算局部地震波速度变化，作者表明虽然主震具有构造起源，但随后的地震活动是由深部裂隙沉积含水层中的流体加压驱动的。余震序列表现出两阶段特征：初始的随机空间分布和随后的流体……

sum: This study presents a novel data integration framework that combines a 25-year seismic catalog with Equivalent Water Height (EWH) datasets from the GRACE-FO satellite mission. By applying Shannon and Tsallis entropy measures, the authors analyze the spatiotemporal evolution of the East Anatolian Fault System surrounding the 2023 Mw 7.8 Kahramanmaraş earthquake doublet. The pre-rupture phase shows rising entropy and falling EWH, indicating stress accumulation and poroelastic contraction. The co-seismic phase exhibits an abrupt entropy spike and negative EWH shift, while the post-seismic phase remains in non-equilibrium due to aftershocks and viscoelastic relaxation. The paper provides structured computational workflows (Algorithms 1 and 2) to link Tsallis entropy with the Gutenberg-Richter b-value, facilitating reproducible seismic entropy analysis.
本研究提出了一种结合25年地震目录与GRACE-FO卫星等效水高（EWH）数据的联合分析框架。通过引入香农（Shannon）和阿玛利斯（Tsallis）信息熵，系统分析了2023年土耳其卡赫拉曼马拉什双震前后东安纳托利亚断裂带的时空演化特征。结果表明，破裂前信息熵上升且EWH下降，反映了应力积累与孔……

sum: This study investigates the sensitivity of the Beibei well-aquifer system to the coupling effect between volumetric and shear strain using high-quality coseismic water-level records from four earthquakes with different azimuths. The authors invert elastic parameters from seismic waves along different azimuths, revealing significant differences that are attributed to crack and damage anisotropy within the fault zone. Notably, the rock damage degree derived from body waves is significantly higher than that from surface waves, indicating more substantial damage along the near-vertical propagation path of body waves. These findings elucidate how fault-zone anisotropy governs hydroseismic responses and offer new insights into the coupled mechanical-hydraulic behavior of aquifer systems under dynamic strain.

sum: This study analyzes the spatial, temporal, and depth variations of seismicity parameters (b-value, fractal dimension Dc, and differential stress) in the Zagros Orogenic Belt using the IRSC catalog (2006-2024). The overall b-value of 0.81 indicates high stress, with lower anomalies (0.4-0.7) tracing major fault zones. High fractal dimensions (Dc >= 1.5) align with low b-values, indicating complex deformation that simplifies with depth. Differential stress (100-520 MPa) anti-correlates with b-value, highlighting critically loaded shallow fault segments and localized seismic hazards.

sum: This study addresses the challenge of seismic source discrimination (e.g., explosions, earthquakes, and collapses) for applications like nuclear test monitoring. The authors assemble an inventory of 1,405 full moment tensor solutions and introduce a novel classification method using anisotropic probability distribution functions on a 5D hypersphere. Employing a Bayesian classifier, they achieve an optimal success rate of 98.4% across all events. They demonstrate that adjusting prior probabilities allows for a flexible trade-off between missing critical events (explosions) and misclassifying common ones (earthquakes). The method moves beyond traditional bipolar screening to generalized multi-source identification and reveals potential subgroupings within source populations, such as distinguishing chemical from nuclear explosions.

sum: This study investigates earthquake scaling relations in the Southern Andes region from 2015 to 2017. Under conditions of small strain and steady seismic moment release rates, the author derives and evaluates empirical scaling equations. The work contributes to understanding how local tectonic stress and strain rates control the scaling behavior of seismicity in active subduction and mountain-building environments, providing key parameters for regional seismic hazard assessment.

sum: This paper presents a comprehensive comparison of five thermodynamic melt-vapor equilibrium tools (D-Compress, VolFe, EVo, Sulfur_X, and MAGEC) for H-O-C-S systems in basaltic magmas (MORB, Kīlauea, Fuego, and Fogo). The authors evaluate how differences in model implementation, such as fO2 buffer equations and sulfur solubility approaches, lead to divergent outputs in gas compositions, melt S and Fe speciation, and fO2. Comparing these with S-free models (MagmaSat, VolatileCalc, Iacono-Marziano) via VESIcal, they find that adding sulfur has minimal impact on vapor saturation pressure, which is instead dominated by the underlying H2O-CO2 calibration datasets. The study highlights the critical need for code transparency, interoperability, and targeted high-pressure/temperature experiments.

sum: This study develops an integrated measurement framework to extract two key frequency eigenquantities—train frequency and bridge frequency—from high-speed railway (HSR) seismic wavefields. By systematizing spectral-line, cepstral, and Doppler descriptions, the authors compare frequency-domain correlation and cepstral strategies for train-frequency estimation, and derive a velocity-independent bridge-frequency estimator from paired Doppler-shifted components. The framework is validated using DAS data from the Beijing–Guangzhou HSR. Results show that bridge frequency is more stable than train frequency. The derived train speeds, carriage lengths, and spatial periodicities align with actual HSR parameters, establishing a quantitative source-characterization basis for DAS-based railway vibration analysis.

sum: This paper proposes a hybrid GNSS/eLoran integrity monitoring framework based on a simplified Receiver Autonomous Integrity Monitoring (RAIM) architecture to address GNSS degradation in satellite-deficient or interference-prone environments. GNSS observations and range-equivalent measurements from the terrestrial eLoran system are jointly processed using a weighted least-squares estimator. Integrity monitoring is performed via a global chi-square consistency test and a solution separation strategy for fault identification and exclusion. Simulation experiments considering satellite faults, eLoran disturbances, and inter-system clock bias demonstrate that the proposed method maintains reliable fault detection and ensures bounded positioning errors.

sum: This paper presents the first experimental measurements of relative dispersion and turbulent diffusion in rapidly-rotating turbulence within the zonostrophic regime, characterized by dominant zonal jets. The authors compute synthetic Lagrangian trajectories from time-resolved experimental velocity fields to analyze relative (two-particle) dispersion. By calculating time-based and separation-based statistics, including the cumulative inverse separation time (CIST), they identify a transition from a Richardson regime at scales larger than the energy-injection scale to a diffusive regime at scales larger than the transitional scale where turbulence becomes anisotropic due to Rossby wave interactions. The CIST analytical predictions enable the measurement of turbulent energy dissipation and diffusivity, showing broad consistency with mixing-length and zonostrophic theories.

sum: This study investigates Middle Triassic felsic volcanic rocks along the Periadriatic Fault System and Mid-Hungarian Shear Zone. Using petrology, mineral chemistry, and U-Pb zircon geochronology, the authors show that ignimbritic rhyolites from Margečan experienced high-pressure, low-temperature blueschist-facies metamorphism (~1.1-1.2 GPa, ~300 °C) during the Cretaceous Eoalpine subduction. In contrast, nearby Kjumberk volcanics show no overprint, retaining their Southern Alpine affinity. This metamorphic contrast redefines the tectonic boundary in this sector, implying that the Margečan units belong to the Austroalpine domain and underwent large-scale eastward lateral extrusion into the Carpathian embayment along major strike-slip faults.
本研究对阿尔卑斯边缘中三叠世长英质火山岩进行了岩石学、矿物化学和锆石U-Pb年代学分析。结果表明，Margečan地区的流纹质凝灰岩经历了白片岩/蓝片岩相高压低温变质作用（~1.1-1.2 GPa, ~300 °C），属于早阿尔卑斯俯冲变质产物；而邻近的Kjumberk火山岩未受变质影响。这一发现重……

结合全岩地球化学、Nd同位素和锆石U-Pb年代学，对多硅白云母进行矿物化学分析。
Middle Triassic felsic volcanic rocks (ignimbrites) from Margečan and Kjumberk areas along the Periadriatic Fault System.
采集自沿周阿尔卑斯断裂带分布的Margečan和Kjumberk地区的中三叠世长英质火山岩。
Discovery of blueschist-facies metamorphism (~1.1-1.2 GPa, ~300 °C) in Margečan ignimbrites, contrasting with the unmetamorphosed Kjumberk volcanics.
在Margečan流纹岩中发现蓝片岩相变质作用（~1.1-1.2 GPa, ~300 °C），而Kjumberk火山岩未…
The study relies on regional tectonic correlations to link the metamorphic overprint to Cretaceous Eoalpine subduction.

Delineated a first-order tectonic boundary between the metamorphic Austroalpine-derived Margečan units and the unmetamorphosed Southern Alpine Kjumberk units.
Proposed a geodynamic model of large-scale eastward lateral extrusion of Adria-derived units accommodated by right-lateral strike-slip faults.

sum: This study presents a repeat geomorphic fault mapping experiment involving 23 participants ranging from undergraduate students to senior professionals. Using pre-earthquake remote sensing data and a systematic geomorphology-based approach, participants mapped regional-scale faults to test the impact of experience on mapping quality. The results show that while professionals slightly outperformed undergraduates, some graduate students produced maps of similar quality to senior professionals. Crucially, all participants missed some tectonic landforms indicative of future ruptures. The study quantifies the inter-mapper epistemic uncertainty in fault location to be between 55 and 117 m, suggesting that experience beyond the graduate level does not significantly improve mapping outcomes and highlighting the inherent uncertainties in fault hazard assessments.
本研究设计了一项由23名不同背景（从本科生到资深专家）的填图人员参与的重复几何断层填图实验。利用震前遥感数据，定量评估了专业经验对断层填图质量的影响。结果表明，尽管专业人员的表现略优于本科生，但部分研究生的填图质量与资深专家相当，且所有参与者均遗漏了指示未来破裂的构造地貌。研究量化了不同填图人员之间……

通过23名不同经验水平的填图人员，利用震前遥感数据进行受控重复断层填图实验。

sum: This paper introduces the Spectro-Spatial Dynamic Graph Neural Network (S2-DyGNN) to address the limitations of static physical topologies in classifying Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) events. The architecture combines a 2D frequency-time convolutional front-end for localized spectro-temporal feature extraction with a dual-matrix graph neural network. The graph module fuses a static physical distance prior with a data-driven adjacency matrix that dynamically updates frame by frame. Evaluated on a highly skewed nine-class DAS field dataset, S2-DyGNN achieved a macro-averaged F1-score of 86.6% and an overall accuracy of 94.0%, significantly outperforming conventional models and improving minority class detection.
本文提出了一种谱-空动态图神经网络（S2-DyGNN），用于解决分布式声学传感（DAS）事件分类中静态物理拓扑的局限性。该架构结合了用于提取局部时频特征的二维卷积前端，以及双矩阵图神经网络。该图模块融合了静态物理距离先验与逐帧动态更新的数据驱动邻接矩阵。在高度不平衡的9类DAS野外数据集上进行评估，……

sum: This study proposes and tests a novel mechanism where subduction-zone earthquakes act as tectonic pumps to return deeply buried marine sediment microbes to near-surface environments. Using poroelastic models constrained by observational benchmarks, the authors show that slip-driven water circulation in outer wedges generates massive global fluid fluxes. This advective transport is physically and biologically feasible, and is supported by a correlation between cumulative seismic forcing and microbial diversity in seeps across the Costa Rica forearc. This tectonic pumping closes the natural selection loop for deep-burial adaptation.
本研究提出并测试了一种新机制：俯冲带地震作为构造泵，将深埋的海洋沉积物微生物输送回近表层环境。利用观测基准约束的孔隙弹性模型，作者表明外楔部滑动驱动的水循环产生了巨大的全球流体通量。这种对流微生物输送在物理和生物学上均可行，且哥斯达黎加前弧渗漏系统的微生物多样性与累积地震力呈正相关。这种构造泵送闭合……

Slip-driven water circulation generates global fluxes exceeding 10^6 Gt/Myr, sufficient to transport 10^26 to 10^30 cells per Myr.

sum: This Nature news/review article highlights four emerging deep-sea technologies transforming ocean-bottom research and hazard monitoring. These include deep-sea drilling ships, advanced sea-floor sensors, and repurposed submarine telecommunication cables (such as SMART cables and DAS). By leveraging acoustic waves and fiber-optic networks, these technologies aim to significantly improve early warning times for deadly earthquakes and tsunamis, providing critical hours of evacuation time for coastal communities.
这篇《自然》新闻综述重点介绍了四种正在改变深海研究与灾害监测的新兴技术，包括深海钻探船、先进海底传感器以及重构的商业海底光缆（如SMART光缆和分布式光纤声学传感DAS）。通过利用水中声波和光纤网络，这些技术旨在显著提高破坏性地震和海啸的预警时效，为沿海地区争取宝贵的避险时间。

sum: This study uses numerical simulations to investigate the formation of dilational bands and the distribution of non-ice materials on Europa's surface. By conducting a parametric study of lateral tectonic extension, the authors demonstrate that dilational bands form under high extensional strain rates, with their specific morphology governed by lithospheric thickness and strength. Furthermore, the models show how extension drives the upward transport of crustal non-ice materials (such as salts) from the subsurface ocean to the surface. The resulting surface composition and spatial distribution of these materials reflect the initial vertical profile of the ice shell, explaining the localized salt concentrations observed by the Galileo mission.
本研究采用数值模拟方法探讨了木卫二表面扩张带的形成及非冰物质的分布。通过对侧向构造拉张进行参数化研究，作者发现扩张带在高速率拉张应变下形成，其具体形态受控于冰壳岩石圈的厚度与强度。此外，模拟表明拉张作用驱动了地壳非冰物质（如盐分）从内部海洋向表面的运移。最终的表面成分和空间分布反映了冰壳初始的垂直剖……

sum: This study investigates the complex stress state within the Copiapó double seismic zone in north-central Chile, a region characterized by seismic swarms and slow-slip events. Using a high-resolution seismic catalog and focal mechanisms for earthquakes (M 2.0-4.6), the researchers performed stress inversions to determine principal stress directions. The results show distinct depth-dependent stress variations: compressional stress near the interplate boundary, extensional regimes in the upper lithospheric mantle, and a novel subhorizontal compressive stress between 80-100 km depth, potentially linked to the subduction of the Copiapó ridge or slab geometry changes. Below 100 km, slab-pull re-establishes an extensional regime. These findings enhance understanding of intraslab seismicity, subducting bathymetric features, and subduction dynamics, identifying potential nucleation zones for future large earthquakes.

sum: This paper presents a theoretical derivation of Richards' equation for unsaturated soil water flow from first principles. Starting from a continuum kinetic equation (CKE) representing pore-filling distributions, the author applies a Chapman-Enskog (CE) reduction controlled by the Damkohler number. This reduction establishes the soil water retention curve at equilibrium and identifies hydraulic conductivity as a first-order transport coefficient. Furthermore, the framework naturally derives dual- and multiple-permeability models for bimodal pore-size distributions, providing a rigorous physical foundation for macroscopic soil hydrology models.

sum: This paper reports the world's first discovery of mantle-derived magmatic anhydrite in ultramafic rocks (clinopyroxenite and hornblendite) from a magmatic platinum group elements (PGE) sulfide deposit, dated at 408.8 Ma. Using Ca-O-C-Fe-S stable isotopes, the study demonstrates that the mantle source was oxidized by recycled surface-derived carbonates following the Palaeozoic Oxygenation Event (POE). This deep Earth redox evolution increased magma oxygen fugacity, suppressing early sulfide saturation and allowing high-Mg basaltic magmas to evolve into PGE-enriched porphyry copper systems. The findings establish a fundamental link between atmospheric oxygenation, deep mantle oxidation, and the secular evolution of strategic metal sulfide deposits.

sum: This study evaluates the interpretation of seismic velocities in the Martian midcrust (11.5–20 km depth) using advanced rock physics modeling. Following recent claims of a vast liquid water aquifer based on InSight seismic data, the authors demonstrate that incorporating realistic variations in pore shape, clay content, and fluid distribution significantly widens the uncertainty bounds. By testing different rock physics bounds and models (such as differential effective medium and Gassmann theories), they show that alternative scenarios—such as dry, gas-filled, or partially saturated porous rocks with specific pore geometries—can equally explain the observed seismic velocities. The study highlights the critical role of rock physics uncertainties in planetary exploration and cautions against overinterpreting sparse seismic data for hydrological conclusions on Mars.

sum: This study investigates the Hongtupo landslide in Wudu District, China, triggered by the 1879 Wudu earthquake. Combining field investigations with numerical modeling, the authors establish a two-dimensional discrete element model calibrated by biaxial tests to simulate the landslide's complete kinematic and dynamic evolution. The simulation shows the landslide lasted 120 seconds, reaching a maximum velocity of 25 m/s and a runout distance of 561 m. The energy evolution was dominated by frictional and collisional dissipation alongside kinetic energy transformation. The landslide's dynamic process is characterized by four distinct stages (initiation, acceleration, deceleration, and stabilization), showing a thrust-driven sliding mechanism where surface and top velocities exceed internal and bottom velocities. The simulated topography matches field observations, offering valuable insights for regional landslide hazard mitigation.

sum: This study investigates the San Juan fault (SJF) in the northern Cascadia forearc to determine if it poses a seismic hazard to southern Vancouver Island. Using high-resolution lidar imagery, the authors map continuous 2-150 m high scarps. To distinguish tectonic deformation from differential glacial erosion, they perform Schmidt hammer hardness measurements, which show harder bedrock on the lowered northern side, supporting a tectonic origin (south-side-up motion). Combined with curved channel offsets, the data suggest dextral-reverse slip. Electrical resistivity tomography (ERT) across an uphill-facing scarp reveals subsurface structural disruptions, providing further evidence of late Quaternary rupture. These findings suggest the SJF is an active fault with prehistoric surface-rupturing earthquakes, highlighting the need for future paleoseismic trenching.
本研究调查了北卡斯卡迪亚前弧的圣胡安断裂（SJF），评估其对温哥华岛南部的地震危险性。利用高分辨率激光雷达，作者绘制了2-150米高的连续陡坎。为区分构造变形与冰川差异侵蚀，施密特锤测量显示下盘（北侧）岩石更硬，证实了构造驱动的南升北降运动。结合弯曲河道错动，表明该断裂存在右旋逆冲滑动。电法电阻率成……

sum: This study presents an integrated reservoir characterization workflow for the Upper Ordovician Mamuniyat Formation in the I/R oil fields, Murzuq Basin, Libya. By combining multi-well petrophysical analysis from eleven wells with 3D seismic interpretation, seismic attribute analysis (variance, RMS amplitude, energy), and spectral decomposition, the authors map the structural framework and reservoir quality. The analysis reveals a NW-SE-trending fault system controlling reservoir compartmentalization and delineates sand-prone fairways. Integrating these seismic indicators with petrophysical properties into a 3D static reservoir model identifies high-quality reservoir zones in the central, northwestern, and southwestern areas. Additionally, two new prospective zones are identified on the upthrown side of the main fault, validated by blind well testing. This integrated approach reduces spatial uncertainty in structurally complex glacial clastic reservoirs.
本研究结合11口井测井、3D地震属性与谱分解，对利比亚储层进行综合表征。研究揭示了控制储层分隔的NW-SE向断裂系统，圈定了优质砂体。通过构建3D静态储层模型，确定了高质量储层区，并在主断层上升盘预测了两个新有利区，盲井验证效果良好，有效降低了复杂储层预测的不确定性。

sum: This study uses 3D numerical thermomechanical modeling with visco-elasto-plastic rheology to investigate rifting dynamics on Venus. By comparing active and inactive rift morphologies, the authors show that wide rift flank uplifts in Ganis, Dali, and Devana Chasmata indicate ongoing or very recent (within tens of millions of years) tectonic activity. The observed topography matches modeled early-stage active rifts with high extension rates of 3–10 cm/yr, suggesting faster extension than previously assumed, likely driven by recent mantle plume activity.
本研究采用3D数值热力学模拟，系统研究了金星裂谷动力学。通过对比活跃与非活跃裂谷地貌，发现Ganis、Dali和Devana裂谷带宽阔的侧翼隆起表明金星目前仍存在活跃的裂谷作用，或活跃于过去几千万年内。模拟结果表明其拉张速率达3-10厘米/年，比此前预估更快，可能与近期活跃的地幔柱活动有关。

t: 3D numerical thermomechanical modeling with visco-elasto-plastic compressible rock rheology to simulate Venusian rifting dynamics.

sum: This study performs a high-resolution seismicity analysis of the mid-crustal earthquake swarm that preceded the 2017 eruption of Mount Agung, Indonesia. By relocating the seismicity, the authors identify two distinct spatial clusters within the mid-crustal dike-related swarm. These findings provide critical insights into the magmatic plumbing system and the pre-eruptive migration of magma/fluids beneath Mount Agung, highlighting the role of dike intrusion in triggering volcanic unrest.
本研究对印度尼西亚阿贡火山2017年喷发前的中地壳地震群进行了高分辨率地震活动性分析。通过对地震进行高精度重定位，作者在与岩脉相关的中地壳震群中识别出两个截然不同的空间地震簇。这些发现为阿贡火山下方的岩浆管道系统及喷发前岩浆/流体的运移提供了关键见解，突出了岩脉侵入在引发火山活动中的作用。

sum: This paper introduces a post-FWI refinement strategy that utilizes a Flow Matching (FM) generative model to inject learned geological priors and well-log information into pre-computed Full-Waveform Inversion (FWI) results. Unlike traditional generative-prior FWI methods that require expensive joint optimization iterations, this approach guides a deterministic generative process post-inversion. Tested on synthetic and field datasets, the method successfully enhances resolution, improves geological consistency, and corrects depth misties by aligning FWI velocity models with well-log constraints without additional wavefield simulations.
本文提出了一种基于流匹配（FM）生成模型的FWI后处理精细化策略，用于在不重新运行高能耗FWI迭代的情况下注入学习到的地质先验和测井信息。该方法在后处理阶段利用FWI结果和测井数据引导确定性生成过程。合成与实际数据实验表明，该方法能有效提高速度模型的分辨率和地质合理性，并在不进行额外波动方程模拟的情……

t: A post-FWI refinement strategy using a Flow Matching generative model to inject geological priors and well logs into existing FWI results without additional wavefield simulations.
利用流匹配生成模型在不重新运行FWI的情况下将地质先验和测井信息注入现有FWI结果中。
Synthetic and field seismic datasets, along with well-log data, used to evaluate resolution enhancement and depth mistie correction.

sum: This study (and its associated Zenodo repository containing MATLAB codes and data) investigates the mechanics of supraglacial lake hydro-fracture. It explores how stress triggering operates across different timescales—viscous, viscoelastic, and elastic. By modeling these processes, the authors shed light on the pre-conditioning and triggering of rapid lake drainage events, which are crucial for understanding ice-sheet dynamics and subglacial hydrology in Greenland and other glaciated regions.

sum: This study investigates global seasonal variations in primary (PM, 14–20 s) and secondary (SM, 4–10 s) microseisms using over 20 years of vertical-component acceleration data from 73 global stations. By fitting four-term Fourier series to seasonally smoothed time series, the authors quantify annual amplitude variations and reveal a distinct hemispheric asymmetry. High-latitude Northern Hemisphere (NH) stations exhibit highly correlated PM and SM variations, driven by intense seasonal storms and coastal wave reflections. Conversely, Southern Hemisphere (SH) stations show widespread PM–SM decorrelation due to different ocean wave states and storm patterns. Additionally, anomalous PM–SM correlations are observed in Antarctica (influenced by sea ice) and East Asia (influenced by monsoons and typhoons). This work highlights how global microseism characteristics reflect large-scale atmospheric-oceanic coupling and hemispheric environmental differences.

sum: This study addresses the limitations of the Tripartite Spatiotemporal Triggering Hypothesis (TSTH) in explaining collective perturbations and small-event increases during major earthquake sequences. Treating global subduction zones as nonlinear elastic waveguide networks saturated with pore fluids, the author proposes a unified 'Impedance-Mismatch and Slow-Wave Diffusion Model.' This model integrates four physical processes: impedance mismatch, poroelastic slow P-wave diffusion, stress corrosion, and frictional-sliding feedback. Retroactive validation using 41 global Mw≥7.5 earthquakes (including the 2004 Sumatra sequence) demonstrates high explanation rates (82.8% for historical and 100% for recent events), outperforming the original TSTH. The model reveals a three-order-of-magnitude regional variation in the slow-wave diffusion coefficient, providing a physical framework for remote earthquake triggering.
本研究提出“阻抗失配与慢波扩散模型”，解决远程地震触发中多源叠加与小震活跃的难题。该模型将俯冲带视为流体饱和的非线性波导网络，耦合了阻抗失配、慢波扩散、应力腐蚀与摩擦反馈。基于41个全球大地震案例的验证表明，该模型对历史和近期事件的解释率达82.8%和100%，显著优于传统模型。

sum: This study analyzes two rare, deep (24.5 km) earthquakes (ML 3.5 and 3.1) that occurred in the southern Bohemian Massif, Czechia, in 2024 and 2025. By integrating instrumental seismological data with over 3,000 crowdsourced macroseismic questionnaires, the authors mapped the spatial distribution of felt intensity (up to IV). The macroseismic response was highly non-circular, showing a strong correlation with regional geology. Specifically, areas underlain by low-attenuation granitoids of the Central Bohemian Pluton exhibited dense, far-reaching reports, whereas the early Palaeozoic sedimentary rocks of the Teplá–Barrandian unit showed sparse reports due to higher attenuation. This demonstrates that citizen science and crowdsourced macroseismic data can effectively map deep crustal attenuation and complement sparse instrumental networks in low-seismicity regions.

sum: This paper presents TL-BiRNN-Pick, an end-to-end automated microseismic monitoring framework for underground mines. To overcome the scarcity of labeled mining data, the authors use transfer learning, pretraining an encoder-decoder bidirectional recurrent neural network on the large-scale DiTing 2.0 natural earthquake dataset and fine-tuning it on mining seismic signals. The framework integrates DBSCAN association, enhanced Geiger localization, and double-difference relocation. Tested on 996 mining waveforms, it achieved an F1 score of 0.933 and an RMSE of 8.23 ms. A 16-day application at the Dongtan Coal Mine detected 1,271 events (a 3-4x increase over traditional methods) and improved the magnitude of completeness to -1.64, demonstrating its effectiveness for mine safety.

sum: This study analyzes ~600 volcano-tectonic (VT) earthquakes during the 1998 pre-eruptive unrest at Piton de la Fournaise volcano, calculating over 400 high-quality fault plane solutions. The results reveal systematic depth-dependent variations in P- and T-axis orientations. Below 1-2 km below sea level, vertical P-axes indicate dominant edifice-loading control, whereas shallower depths exhibit horizontal, dike-perpendicular P-axes driven by tectonic compression and dike-induced stress. By combining these observations with a 2D damage-based dike propagation model and 3D elastic models of tectonic stress and edifice loading, the authors demonstrate that dike-induced seismicity can probe depth-variable local stress fields during magma migration. This provides a qualitative and semi-quantitative framework for interpreting pre-eruptive seismicity.
本研究分析了留尼汪富尔奈斯火山1998年喷发前活跃期记录的约600个火山构造（VT）地震，计算出400多个高质量断层面解。结果显示P轴和T轴方向存在系统的深度依赖性：海平面以下1-2公里深处，P轴主要呈垂直向，受火山体负载控制；而在较浅深度，P轴转为水平且垂直于岩脉，受构造挤压和岩脉侵入应力扰动控制……

t: Focal mechanism determination using manually picked first-motion polarities, combined with 2D damage-based dike propagation and 3D elastic stress modeling.
利用手动拾取的初动极性确定震源机制，并结合二维损伤岩脉传播和三维弹性应力建模。

富尔奈斯火山1998年喷发前活跃期记录的约600个火山构造地震的波形数据。
Over 400 fault plane solutions reveal vertical P-axes below 1-2 km (edifice-loading) and horizontal, dike-perpendicular P-axes at shallower depths (tectonic/dike stress).
400多个断层面解揭示深部（>1-2 km）P轴垂直（火山负载），浅部P轴水平且垂直于岩脉（构造/岩脉应力）。
The combined modeling approach provides mostly qualitative insights with limited semi-quantitative constraints on the local stress field.
联合建模方法主要提供定性认识，对局部应力场的半定量约束有限。
Demonstrating depth-dependent stress transitions during dike propagation by integrating high-density focal mechanisms with damage-based and elastic stress models.
通过将高密度震源机制与损伤及弹性应力模型结合，首次展示了岩脉传播过程中的深度依赖性应力转变。

kc: Calculated over 400 high-quality fault plane solutions for the 1998 pre-eruptive unrest at Piton de la Fournaise.
Identified a systematic depth-dependent transition in stress control from edifice-loading (deep) to tectonic and dike-induced stress (shallow).
Integrated 2D damage-based dike propagation and 3D elastic stress models to explain the observed focal mechanism variations.
计算了富尔奈斯火山1998年喷发前活跃期的400多个高质量断层面解。
发现了应力控制随深度变化的系统性转变：深部受火山体负载控制，浅部受构造和岩脉应力控制。
结合2D损伤岩脉传播模型和3D弹性应力模型，解释了观测到的震源机制变化。

2D damage-based dike propagation modeling.
3D elastic modeling of tectonic stress and edifice loading.

sum: This study investigates the geodynamical regime of Venus by analyzing its volcanic plains, which cover 77% of the planet. The authors identify three distinct lithospheric provinces with statistically different properties. While the Beta-Atla-Themis region features a thick crust and highly variable effective elastic thickness ($T_e$), the remaining plains (61% of Venus) show a clear north-south dichotomy. The northern plains possess a thinner lithosphere and twice the spatial density of volcanoes compared to the southern plains. These global-scale lateral variations in mechanical properties challenge uniform planetary evolution models and suggest a complex, heterogeneous mantle convection regime on Venus.
本研究分析了金星火山平原，发现三个具有不同岩石圈性质的区域。除Beta-Atla-Themis区具有厚地壳外，其余平原呈现南北双重性：北部平原岩石圈较薄，且单位面积火山数量是南部的两倍。这些全球尺度的力学性质差异表明金星存在复杂的地球动力学机制和显著的侧向非均匀性，为行星演化模型提供了重要约束。

t: Statistical and spatial analysis of Venusian lithospheric properties, including effective elastic thickness and crustal thickness, across different volcanic provinces.
对不同火山分区金星岩石圈性质（包括有效弹性厚度和地壳厚度）进行统计和空间分析。
Global planetary datasets of Venusian topography, gravity, and volcano distributions across the volcanic plains covering 77% of the surface.
覆盖金星77%表面的火山平原全球地形、重力和火山分布数据集。
Discovery of three distinct lithospheric provinces, including a north-south dichotomy where northern plains have thinner lithosphere and twice the volcano density of southern plains.
发现三个不同的岩石圈分区，包括北部平原岩石圈较薄且火山密度是南部两倍的南北双重性。
Relies on indirect gravity and topography observations without direct seismic constraints on lithospheric structure.
依赖于间接的重力和地形观测，缺乏对岩石圈结构的直接地震学约束。
First to demonstrate a statistically significant global-scale lithospheric heterogeneity and north-south dichotomy in Venusian volcanic plains.
首次证实金星火山平原中存在统计学上显著的全球尺度岩石圈非均匀性和南北双重性。

kc: Identified three statistically distinct lithospheric provinces within Venusian volcanic plains.
Discovered a north-south lithospheric dichotomy where northern plains have a thinner lithosphere and double the volcano density of southern plains.
Provided global-scale constraints on Venusian lateral mechanical variations to guide mantle convection models.
在金星火山平原中识别出三个在统计学上具有显著差异的岩石圈分区。
发现了南北岩石圈的双重性，其中北部平原的岩石圈较薄，且火山密度是南部平原的两倍。
提供了金星全球尺度侧向力学变化的约束，为地幔对流模型提供了指导。

Spatial density mapping and correlation of volcanoes across different provinces.
对金星火山平原的岩石圈性质（地壳厚度和有效弹性厚度）进行统计分析。

Global database of Venusian volcanoes and volcanic plains.
用于估算岩石圈性质的金星全球地形和重力数据（可能来自麦哲伦号任务）。
金星火山及火山平原的全球数据库。
li: The study relies on indirect geophysical estimates of lithospheric thickness and crustal properties without direct seismic calibration.
The exact geodynamical mechanisms driving the observed lithospheric dichotomy remain to be fully modeled.
该研究依赖于对岩石圈厚度和地壳性质的间接地球物理估算，缺乏直接的地震学标定。
导致所观测到的岩石圈双重性的具体地球动力学机制仍有待完整的模型模拟。

tm.why: The paper investigates the crustal and lithospheric thickness variations of Venus to understand its geodynamical regime.
The study focuses on planetary geophysics, specifically analyzing the volcanic plains and lithosphere of Venus.

sum: This study addresses the challenge of monitoring groundwater storage anomalies in data-scarce regions like Ghana. Using GRACE satellite gravity data from 2004 to 2024, the authors apply an unsupervised machine learning framework based on Isolation Forest combined with Z-score standardization. The analysis successfully identifies 12 anomalous months (5 deficit and 7 surplus events), revealing persistent deficits from 2004 to 2009 and increasing surpluses after 2018. The machine learning approach outperforms conventional statistical thresholds by capturing subtle deviations, providing a robust framework for hydrological monitoring.
本研究针对加纳等缺乏实测数据的地区，利用2004至2024年的GRACE卫星重力观测数据监测地下水储量异常。研究采用Z-score标准化与无监督机器学习算法（孤立森林）构建检测框架，成功识别出12个异常月份（5个亏缺和7个盈余事件）。结果表明，2004-2009年存在持续的地下水亏缺，而2018年后……

t: An unsupervised machine learning framework using Isolation Forest combined with Z-score standardization to detect groundwater storage anomalies.
结合Z-score标准化与孤立森林无监督机器学习算法检测地下水储量异常。
GRACE satellite-derived groundwater storage anomaly data from 2004 to 2024 covering Ghana.
覆盖加纳地区的2004至2024年GRACE卫星重力反演地下水储量异常数据。
Identified 12 anomalous months (5 deficit, 7 surplus), showing persistent deficits in 2004-2009 and increasing surpluses after 2018.
识别出12个异常月份（5个亏缺，7个盈余），显示2004-2009年持续亏缺及2018年后盈余增加。
Limited long-term in-situ observations for validation and coarse spatial resolution of GRACE data.
缺乏用于验证的长期实地观测数据，且GRACE空间分辨率较粗。
Application of unsupervised Isolation Forest to GRACE data for capturing subtle groundwater anomalies beyond conventional statistical thresholds.
将无监督孤立森林应用于GRACE数据，捕捉到传统统计阈值法无法发现的微弱异常。

kc: Developed an unsupervised machine learning framework using Isolation Forest for groundwater anomaly detection.
Identified 12 major groundwater storage anomaly events in Ghana over a 20-year period (2004-2024).
Demonstrated that the machine learning approach captures subtle hydrological deviations missed by conventional statistical thresholds.
开发了基于孤立森林无监督机器学习的地下水异常检测框架。
识别出加纳20年间（2004-2024年）的12次重大地下水储量异常事件。
证实了机器学习方法能够捕捉到传统统计阈值法所忽略的微弱水文偏差。

Isolation Forest ensemble-based unsupervised machine learning for anomaly detection.
地下水储量异常的Z-score标准化。
基于孤立森林集成学习的无监督异常检测。

sum: This paper proposes the Streamflow Alteration Index (SAI), a network-based screening metric designed to propagate point-based streamflow alteration signals (e.g., from dams and reservoirs) downstream through a routing network. The framework defines two indices, SAI_I and SAI_II, representing confirmed and potential alteration sources. Applied to Ontario, Canada, using the Ontario Lake and River Routing Product Version 2 (OLRRP v2) and an inventory of 643 alteration sources, the resulting SAI v1.0 database provides high-resolution, subbasin-scale mapping at both gauged and ungauged nodes. Validation against independent reference gauges showed high accuracy in classifying natural basins, demonstrating SAI's utility as an objective screening tool for large-scale hydrologic and aquatic applications without requiring detailed dam operations.
本文提出了基于河网的筛选指标——径流改变指数（SAI），用于将大坝和水库等点源径流改变信号沿汇流网络向下游传播。该框架包含代表确切和潜在改变源的SAI_I和SAI_II双指数。研究利用安大略湖泊与河流汇流产品第二版（OLRRP v2）及643个改变源清单，构建了加拿大安大略省的SAI v1.0数据库……

t: The Streamflow Alteration Index (SAI) propagates point-based alteration signals downstream through a routing network using paired indices (SAI_I and SAI_II) representing confirmed and potential alteration sources.
径流改变指数（SAI）通过汇流网络向下游传播点源改变信号，采用代表确切和潜在改变源的双指数。
The method was implemented in Ontario, Canada, using the Ontario Lake and River Routing Product Version 2 (OLRRP v2) and an inventory of 643 alteration signal sources.
在安大略省应用，使用安大略湖泊与河流汇流产品第二版（OLRRP v2）及643个改变源清单。
SAI classified 86% of RHBN natural gauges and 86% of WSC-natural gauges as natural, while 74% of WSC-regulated gauges were classified as conditional or natural.
SAI将86%的RHBN和WSC天然流量站正确分类为天然，将74%的WSC调节流量站分类为条件或天然。
The framework provides potential streamflow alteration screening without requiring detailed dam operating information, meaning it does not model actual real-time reservoir operations.
该框架提供潜在径流改变的筛选，未考虑具体的水坝实时运行规则。
Unlike existing indicators that quantify alteration only at discrete locations, SAI provides spatially continuous, network-based mapping at both gauged and ungauged nodes.
相比于仅在离散位置量化改变的现有指标，SAI实现了基于河网的有测站和无测站节点空间连续制图。

kc: Proposed the Streamflow Alteration Index (SAI) framework for downstream propagation of point-based alteration signals.
Developed the SAI v1.0 database providing subbasin-scale mapping of streamflow alteration across Ontario, Canada.
Validated the index against independent reference datasets, achieving high classification accuracy for natural gauges.
提出了用于点源改变信号下游传播的径流改变指数（SAI）框架。
开发了SAI v1.0数据库，提供了加拿大安大略省子流域尺度的径流改变制图。

Relies on the accuracy of the underlying routing network and the completeness of the alteration source inventory.

sum: This study presents array-scale anisotropic shear-velocity models of the Pacific upper mantle using data from two ocean-bottom seismometer (OBS) arrays of the ORCA experiment: Young ORCA (~43 Ma) and Old ORCA (~90 Ma). By combining Rayleigh-wave (5–150 s) and Love-wave (5–10 s) phase velocities, the authors constrain shear velocity, radial anisotropy, and azimuthal anisotropy down to 300 km depth. The results reveal a lithospheric lid thickening with age. Young ORCA exhibits moderate lithospheric azimuthal anisotropy (~3%) aligned with fossil spreading, whereas Old ORCA shows weak, rotated anisotropy. Both regions feature strong asthenospheric anisotropy (~3%) aligned with absolute plate motion at 70–200 km depth, underlain by deeper flow-induced rotations. This highlights the capacity of dense OBS arrays to resolve small-scale lithosphere-asthenosphere deformation.
本研究利用太平洋ORCA实验中两个海底地震仪（OBS）台阵（年轻台阵~43 Ma和年老台阵~90 Ma）的数据，构建了阵列尺度的上地幔各向异性剪切波速度模型。通过联合反演5-150秒瑞利波和5-10秒勒夫波相速度，约束了300公里深度内的速度与各向异性结构。结果显示岩石圈厚度随板块年龄增加。年轻台阵……

t: Inversion of Rayleigh-wave (5–150 s) and Love-wave (5–10 s) phase velocities to resolve shear-velocity structure, radial anisotropy, and azimuthal anisotropy.
联合反演瑞利波（5-150秒）和勒夫波（5-10秒）相速度，约束剪切波速度、径向各向异性和方位各向异性。
Seismic data from two Pacific ocean-bottom seismometer (OBS) arrays of the ORCA experiment: Young ORCA (~43 Ma) and Old ORCA (~90 Ma).
来自太平洋ORCA实验中两个海底地震仪（OBS）台阵（年轻ORCA ~43 Ma，年老ORCA ~90 Ma）的地震数据…
Young ORCA shows ~3% lithospheric azimuthal anisotropy; Old ORCA shows weak (1%-2%) rotated anisotropy. Both show ~3% asthenospheric anisotropy aligned with absolute plate motion.
年轻台阵具~3%岩石圈方位各向异性；年老台阵具1%-2%旋转各向异性。两者软流圈均具~3%与绝对板块运动平行的各向异性。
Resolution of smaller-scale lateral variations and deeper asthenospheric flow is limited by the array aperture and frequency range of surface waves.
受台阵孔径和面波频率范围限制，对更深部软流圈流动和更小尺度横向变化的约束能力有限。
First array-scale anisotropic models from the ORCA experiment comparing young and old Pacific lithosphere-asthenosphere systems, revealing depth-varying and rotated anisotropy.
首次利用ORCA实验台阵对比研究年轻与年老太平洋岩石圈-软流圈系统，揭示了随深度变化的各向异性结构。

kc: Constructed array-scale anisotropic shear-velocity models for young (~43 Ma) and old (~90 Ma) Pacific upper mantle.
Identified a sharp lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary (LAB) at ~70 km depth in the older Pacific plate.
Revealed strong asthenospheric anisotropy (~3%) aligned with absolute plate motion, indicating plate-induced shear.
构建了年轻（~43 Ma）和年老（~90 Ma）太平洋上地幔阵列尺度的各向异性剪切波速度模型。
在较老太平洋板块约70公里深度处识别出清晰的岩石圈-软流圈边界（LAB）。
揭示了与绝对板块运动方向一致的强软流圈各向异性（~3%），表明存在板块驱动的剪切作用。
me: Combined Rayleigh-wave phase velocities (5–150 s) and Love-wave phase velocities (5–10 s).
Inverted dispersion data for shear-wave velocity, radial anisotropy, and azimuthal anisotropy.
联合了5-150秒的瑞利波相速度和5-10秒的勒夫波相速度。
反演频散数据以约束剪切波速度、径向各向异性和方位各向异性。
de: Seismic data from two ocean-bottom seismometer (OBS) arrays of the ORCA experiment in the Pacific Ocean.
来自太平洋ORCA实验中两个海底地震仪（OBS）台阵的地震数据。
li: Resolution of deeper asthenospheric structures and small-scale lateral variations is limited by array aperture and surface-wave frequency bands.
受台阵孔径和面波频段限制，对更深部软流圈结构和小尺度横向变化的解析度有限。

tm.why: The paper presents anisotropic shear-velocity models to constrain seismic anisotropy in the Pacific mantle.
The study investigates the lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary and mantle flow beneath the Pacific plate.
The models are constructed using Rayleigh and Love wave phase velocity dispersion measurements.

sum: This study investigates sub-arc melting beneath the Alaska Peninsula using P-wave attenuation measurements. The results reveal significant along-strike variations in mantle wedge melting, with high attenuation anomalies in the Pavlof and Chirikof-Kodiak segments indicating extensive slab dehydration and partial melting, contrasted by limited melting in the Shumagin-Chignik segments. Interestingly, these mantle wedge melting variations do not directly correlate with surface volcanic patterns. Instead, abrupt crustal structure changes across the Becharof discontinuity (imaged by Vp/Vs tomography) suggest that surface volcanism is strongly modulated by trans-crustal processes, such as upper-crustal stress regimes, alongside mantle magma supply. Additionally, strong scattering attenuation in the fore-arc crust indicates widespread deformation southwest of Chirikof Island.
本研究利用P波衰减成像探讨阿拉斯加半岛弧下熔融。结果显示地幔楔熔融存在显著的沿走向变化，受板块脱水控制。然而，地幔楔熔融程度与地表火山特征不完全对应。结合地壳Vp/Vs结构，表明地表火山活动除受地幔岩浆供应外，还受上地壳应力等跨地壳过程调制。前弧强散射衰减指示了广泛的变形。

t: P-wave attenuation tomography is used to image the attenuation structure (Qp^-1) of the mantle wedge and crust, reflecting temperature and partial melt variations.
利用P波衰减成像技术反演地幔楔和地壳的衰减结构，以反映温度和部分熔融的变化。
Seismic waveform data from local and regional earthquakes recorded by the seismic network along the Alaska Peninsula.
利用阿拉斯加半岛沿线地震台网记录到的地方和区域地震波形数据。

Revealed high attenuation anomalies in Pavlof and Chirikof-Kodiak segments, low attenuation in Shumagin-Chignik, and a mismatch between mantle melting and surface volcanism, suggesting trans-crustal modulation.
发现地幔楔熔融存在显著的沿走向变化，且地表火山活动受到跨地壳过程的强烈调制。
The study relies on qualitative comparisons between attenuation and velocity models, and resolution may be limited by regional network coverage.
该研究依赖于衰减与速度模型的定性对比，且分辨率受区域台网覆盖限制。
First detailed P-wave attenuation model of the Alaska Peninsula mantle wedge, demonstrating that trans-crustal processes, not just mantle supply, control surface volcanism variations.
首次建立该区P波衰减模型，阐明跨地壳过程在调制地表火山活动中的关键作用。

kc: Mapped along-strike variations in mantle wedge attenuation beneath the Alaska Peninsula, linking them to slab dehydration and partial melting.
Demonstrated a mismatch between mantle wedge melting intensity and surface volcanic patterns, highlighting the role of trans-crustal processes.
Identified strong scattering attenuation in the fore-arc crust southwest of Chirikof Island, indicating widespread deformation.
绘制了阿拉斯加半岛下方地幔楔衰减的沿走向变化，并将其与板块脱水和部分熔融联系起来。
展示了地幔楔熔融强度与地表火山模式之间的不匹配，突出了跨地壳过程的作用。
在Chirikof岛西南的前弧地壳中发现了强烈的散射衰减，指示了广泛的变形。
me: P-wave attenuation (Qp^-1) tomography to image temperature and partial melt variations.
Comparison with previously published seismic velocity (Vp, Vs) and Vp/Vs tomography models.
利用P波衰减（Qp^-1）成像来约束温度和部分熔融的变化。
与先前发表的地震波速度（Vp、Vs）及Vp/Vs成像模型进行对比分析。
de: Seismic waveform data from local/regional earthquakes recorded by stations along the Alaska Peninsula.
利用阿拉斯加半岛沿线台站记录到的地方及区域地震波形数据。
li: Resolution of attenuation tomography might be limited by station distribution and ray coverage.

sum: This study investigates the robustness of neural network-based reparameterized full-waveform inversion (FWI) by visualizing its loss landscape geometry. Addressing the challenges of vertical seismic profiling (VSP) data—such as limited acquisition geometry, sparse receivers, and lack of low frequencies—the authors demonstrate how neural network parameterization reshapes the optimization landscape to avoid local minima. Based on these insights, they propose a physics-informed Transformer-based reparameterized FWI framework (PIT-FWI) for VSP velocity inversion. Synthetic experiments on the Sigsbee model show that PIT-FWI significantly outperforms conventional FWI and UNet-based reparameterized FWI in accuracy and stability under degraded conditions, including inaccurate initial models, low signal-to-noise ratios, and missing low frequencies.

sum: This study presents a seismological investigation of subaqueous slopes in Lake Lucerne, Switzerland, using Ocean Bottom Seismometers (OBS) in single-station and array configurations. Ambient-noise data were processed to extract microtremor horizontal-to-vertical (H/V) spectral ratios and phase-velocity dispersion curves of Scholte and Love waves. These observables were jointly inverted to estimate shear-wave velocity (VS) profiles. Crucially, the inversion utilized the forward-modeling tool hvgeneralized, which computes the full H/V spectrum while explicitly accounting for the overlying water layer and water-sediment coupling. This approach overcomes the limitations of standard land-based assumptions. The resulting VS profiles characterize the internal structure of unconsolidated lacustrine sediments, demonstrating the efficacy of OBS-based passive seismic methods for subaqueous landslide hazard assessment.

sum: This publication is an Author Correction to a previously published study that evaluates the landslide hazards and risks associated with new and existing settlements constructed on hillslopes weakened by the 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquake sequence in Turkey. The original study highlights the critical need for post-earthquake landslide susceptibility assessments to guide safe reconstruction and urban planning, preventing future disasters in seismically weakened mountainous terrains.

sum: BackTrackBB is an open-source program designed for the detection and space-time location of seismic sources. It utilizes multi-scale, frequency-selective statistical coherence of wavefields recorded by dense seismic networks and local arrays. This specific Zenodo release documents a benchmark experiment configuration using a synthetic dataset to evaluate the software's performance on the Marenostrum V supercomputer. The workflow runs over a simulated 2-day period, generating 1,300 tasks (including 864 computationally intensive btbb_block tasks). Utilizing 108 nodes, the execution completes in approximately 11 minutes, though CPU usage averages 35.2% due to load imbalances. This release highlights the tool's high-performance computing capabilities for large-scale seismic monitoring.

sum: This study investigates the September 2022 Chihshang earthquake sequence (Mw 6.6 foreshock and Mw 7.0 mainshock) in Taitung, Taiwan, to understand earthquake nucleation and triggering mechanisms. By integrating seismic waveforms (Pn/Pg and Rayleigh waves) and InSAR deformation data, the authors construct a three-fault rupture model. Relative hypocenter and centroid locations are determined and validated using GNSS and InSAR observations. Static Coulomb stress change calculations reveal that subsequent subevents were triggered by preceding ones, demonstrating a cascading rupture process. This study highlights the complex interaction of faults during the sequence and provides critical insights for assessing seismic hazards in regions with increased stress.

sum: This study re-evaluates a circular geomorphological feature in the Venezuelan Guiana Shield, historically suspected to be an impact crater since the 1980s. Using modern digital elevation models from the Shuttle Radar Topography Mission (SRTM), the authors analyze the structure's morphology. They find that it lacks the diagnostic features of impact craters and instead matches the characteristics of the Nuria ring dike intrusive complex. By comparing it with analogous structures like the Kondyor massif, the paper demonstrates that circular morphology alone is insufficient for impact crater identification, highlighting the value of modern high-resolution topographic data in resolving historical geological ambiguities.

sum: This paper presents a method to construct geological horizon surfaces near complex, intersecting fault networks. By formalizing the fault system as a simplicial complex and modeling the domain as a gamma-neighborhood of the cut graph on the triangulation, the author replaces traditional retriangulation with mesh deformation. The free boundary movement formula is generalized to handle various sub-edge endpoint combinations. Utilizing an edge-based discretization of the area functional, the optimization problem is decomposed into independent systems of linear algebraic equations for each subdomain, enabling efficient iterative solving. The method is successfully demonstrated on real geological datasets.
本文提出了一种在复杂的相交断层网络附近构建地质层位表面的方法。通过将断层系统形式化为单纯复形，并将建模区域构建为三角剖分上割图的伽马邻域，作者用网格变形取代了传统的重新三角剖分。自由边界移动公式被推广到处理各种子边端点组合。利用面积泛函的基于边的离散化，该优化问题在每次迭代中被分解为每个子域的独立线……

Tested and validated using real geological datasets containing complex, intersecting fault networks and horizon surfaces.
使用包含复杂相交断层网络和层位表面的真实地质数据集进行测试和验证。
Successfully reconstructs geological horizons near intersecting faults by solving independent systems of linear algebraic equations at each iteration.

Requires pre-defined fault networks and initial triangulations, which may introduce errors if the input geometry is poorly constrained.

Generalizes horizon modeling to intersecting fault networks using mesh deformation instead of retriangulation and edge-based discretization.

sum: The paper introduces osm.R, a graphical user interface (GUI) application designed to model open-system melting (OSM) in the Earth's upper mantle. OSM models are highly comprehensive, incorporating melt segregation, interaction, and crystallization, but are traditionally difficult to implement due to complex parameterizations. osm.R allows users to simulate trace-element behavior in residues and melts and perform best-fit estimations against observed data without coding. The authors demonstrate its utility by applying it to clinopyroxene from abyssal peridotites, successfully reproducing rare earth element (REE) patterns and providing more reliable estimates of melting degrees and critical melt fractions than traditional fractional melting models.
本文介绍了osm.R，一个用于模拟上地幔开放系统熔融（OSM）的图形用户界面（GUI）应用程序。OSM模型整合了熔体分离、相互作用和结晶过程，但因参数设置复杂而难以应用。osm.R使用户无需编程即可模拟残余物和熔体中的微量元素行为，并对观测数据进行最佳拟合估算。作者将其应用于深海橄榄岩中的单斜辉石，……

Provides the first code-free, GUI-based tool for complex open-system melting calculations, making advanced geochemical modeling accessible to non-programmers.

sum: This study uses thermodynamic phase assemblage modeling to predict the evolution of mineralogy and fluid compositions during subduction along representative pressure-temperature (PT) paths. By evaluating both closed and open systems for hydrated harzburgite, hydrated mid-ocean ridge basalt (MORB), average subducted sediments, and subducted carbonates, the authors identify unique fluid solute ratios characteristic of specific source lithologies. For instance, sediment-derived fluids exhibit higher Na/(Mg+Si) ratios compared to basalt-derived fluids, while deserpentinization of harzburgite yields fluids rich in Mg and Ca. These modeled major-element signatures provide a valuable framework for identifying the sources of metasomatizing fluids in the subducting slab and overlying mantle wedge, consistent with natural rock records and fluid inclusions.
本研究利用热力学相平衡模拟，预测了俯冲带代表性温压路径下矿物与流体成分的演化。通过模拟水化哈茨木石、玄武岩、沉积物和碳酸盐岩，识别出特定源岩的流体溶质特征：沉积物流体具高Na/Mg和Na/Si比，而哈茨木石脱蛇纹石化流体富含Mg和Ca。这些特征为追踪俯冲带及地幔楔交代流体来源提供了有效工具。

t: Thermodynamic phase assemblage modeling to calculate equilibrium mineralogy and fluid compositions under closed and open system assumptions along representative subduction PT-paths.
利用相平衡热力学模拟，计算代表性俯冲温压路径下开放与封闭系统的平衡矿物与流体成分。
Simplified chemical compositions representing hydrated harzburgite, hydrated mid-ocean ridge basalt (MORB), average subducted sediments, and subducted carbonates.
代表水化哈茨木石、水化洋中脊玄武岩、平均俯冲沉积物和俯冲碳酸盐岩的简化化学成分。
Sediment-derived fluids have higher Na to Mg and Si ratios than basalt-derived fluids, while deserpentinization of hydrated harzburgite produces fluids with higher Mg and Ca proportions.
沉积物来源流体具有较高的Na/Mg和Na/Si比，而哈茨木石脱蛇纹石化流体富含Mg和Ca。
The thermodynamic models rely on simplified chemical systems and equilibrium assumptions, which may not fully capture kinetic barriers or complex natural fluid-rock pathways.
热力学模型依赖于简化的化学体系和平衡假设，可能无法完全模拟动力学限制。
Systematically fingerprints fluid source lithologies during subduction by identifying unique major-element solute ratios (e.g., Na/Mg/Si vs Mg/Ca) from thermodynamic phase modeling.
通过热力学相模拟识别出独特的常量元素溶质比例，系统性地指征了俯冲带流体的源岩性。

识别出可用于指征流体来源的独特常量元素溶质比例（如Na/Mg/Si与Mg/Ca）。

sum: This study measures the vanadium (V) isotopic compositions of Paleogene Baffin Island lavas, which erupted above the Iceland plume head, to investigate the source of deep mantle heterogeneities. The lavas exhibit significantly lighter V isotopic compositions (δ51V = -0.96 ± 0.02‰) compared to typical mantle-derived lavas (δ51V = -0.89 ± 0.02‰). This light signature cannot be explained by crustal assimilation, fractional crystallization, mantle melting, or sediment recycling. Instead, the authors propose that these lavas either sample an ancient (>3 Ga) melt-depleted mantle reservoir or, more likely, incorporate core-affected material. They hypothesize that V partitioned into core-exsolved oxides, imparting a core-like isotopic signature to the mantle source, providing evidence for core-mantle chemical interaction.
本研究测量了喷发于冰岛地幔柱头部之上的古近纪巴芬岛熔岩的钒（V）同位素组成，以探究深部地幔非均匀性的来源。结果显示，这些熔岩的V同位素组成（δ51V = -0.96 ± 0.02‰）显著轻于大多数地幔来源熔岩（-0.89 ± 0.02‰）。该轻同位素特征无法用陆壳同化、结晶分异、地幔熔融或沉积物循环……

t: High-precision vanadium isotope ratio (51V/50V) measurements of lava samples, compared statistically against global mantle-derived lava databases.
对熔岩样品进行高精度钒同位素比值（51V/50V）测量，并与全球地幔熔岩数据库进行统计对比。
Vanadium isotopic compositions (δ51V) of 25 Paleogene Baffin Island lava samples, compared with 69 mantle-derived lavas from literature.
25个古近纪巴芬岛熔岩样品的钒同位素组成数据，以及文献中69个地幔熔岩的对比数据。
Baffin Island lavas have significantly lighter V isotopic compositions (-0.96 ± 0.02‰) than typical mantle-derived lavas (-0.89 ± 0.02‰) with 99.8% confidence.
巴芬岛熔岩的V同位素组成（-0.96 ± 0.02‰）显著轻于典型地幔熔岩（-0.89 ± 0.02‰）。
The exact physical mechanism of core-mantle interaction and V partitioning into core-exsolved oxides remains hypothetical and difficult to verify directly.
核幔相互作用及钒向地核析出氧化物中分配的具体物理机制仍属假说，难以直接验证。
First report of anomalous light vanadium isotopic compositions in high-3He/4He Baffin Island lavas, linking V isotopes to potential core-mantle boundary interactions.
首次报道高3He/4He巴芬岛熔岩中异常偏轻的钒同位素组成，并将其与核幔边界相互作用联系起来。

sum: This paper presents a novel deep learning approach for real-time multi-station microseismic event detection using the YOLOv5 computer vision model. Continuous multi-channel seismic data are converted into 20-second grayscale waveform images, where microseismic events are manually annotated. By leveraging transfer learning from pre-trained computer vision models, the network is trained on field-observed datasets. Compared to traditional STA/LTA and existing multi-station schemes, the proposed method significantly reduces false positives while maintaining a high recall rate. When tested on an independent dataset from a different area, the model achieved a precision of 0.9832 and a recall of 0.9702. The method is robust, computationally efficient for real-time monitoring, and easily updatable with new training samples.

sum: The authors propose a novel joint analysis method that integrates geodetic slip-deficit rate models with focal mechanisms of intraplate earthquakes near the plate interface. By evaluating whether focal mechanisms align with geodetically derived stressing rates, the method detects deviations from steady-state coupling. Applied to the Tohoku-Oki plate boundary over 25 years, it successfully captures pre-seismic partial decoupling, decadal aseismic slip evolution, and fine-scale spatial heterogeneities. This approach overcomes the resolution limits of pure geodetic inversions, offering a powerful tool for monitoring subduction zone dynamics and improving seismic hazard assessments.

sum: This study presents a high-precision relocated seismicity catalog for northwestern South America to investigate intermediate-depth earthquakes. The refined earthquake locations reveal a highly complex subducting slab geometry and delineate multiple distinct seismicity clusters, including the well-known Bucaramanga nest. These high-resolution spatial patterns provide critical constraints on the deformation, dehydration, and stress state of the subducting Nazca and Caribbean plates beneath Colombia, advancing our understanding of intermediate-depth earthquake triggering mechanisms and regional geodynamics.
本研究通过高精度重新定位的地震目录，分析了西北南美洲的中源地震活动。精细的地震定位揭示了极其复杂的俯冲板块几何结构，并清晰刻画了包括布卡拉曼加（Bucaramanga）地震巢在内的多个独立地震群。这些高分辨率的空间分布特征为理解哥伦比亚下方纳斯卡板块和加勒比板块的俯冲变形、脱水机制及应力状态提供了关……

sum: This paper introduces a physics-based AI approach to earthquake forecasting by coupling subduction multi-physics with AI-assisted manifold detection. Focusing on slow slip events driven by dehydration reactions in subduction zones, the authors develop a physics-based attractor to filter noise from surface displacement series. Applying this method to New Zealand's Hikurangi trench, they successfully forecast an earthquake one week in advance, with predictability limits extending up to 5-6 weeks. The study demonstrates decadal repeatability, suggesting a deterministic mechanism for physics-based seismic forecasting.
本文提出了一种结合物理多物理场与人工智能流形检测的地震预测方法。针对俯冲带脱水反应驱动的慢滑移事件，作者构建了物理吸引子以消除地表位移数据中的噪声。在纽西兰希库朗伊海沟的应用中，该方法成功提前一周预测了地震，且预测极限可达5-6周，并具有十年尺度的可重复性。该研究表明了该物理机制的确定性，为基于物理……

sum: This study documents the global prevalence of anti-similar earthquakes—events with nearly identical but polarity-flipped waveforms—at intermediate depths. The authors identify new occurrences in Colombia (beyond the Bucaramanga Nest), the Alaska subduction zone, and the Vrancea nest in Romania. Combined with existing observations from Japan and Chile, these findings suggest that anti-similar sequences are a characteristic feature of intermediate-depth seismicity. The authors propose that these events are driven by either conjugate faulting (potentially promoted by eclogitization-induced stresses) or sub-parallel faulting. This work expands our understanding of intermediate-depth earthquake physics and faulting mechanisms.
本研究揭示了中源深度反相似地震（即波形几乎相同但极性相反的地震）的全球普适性。作者在哥伦比亚（除布卡拉曼加巢外的新区域）、阿拉斯加俯冲带和罗马尼亚弗朗恰（Vrancea）地震巢中发现了新的反相似地震。结合日本和智利的已有报道，这些新观测表明反相似地震序列可能是中源地震的特征性过程。其物理机制可解释为……

Seismic waveform datasets from intermediate-depth zones in Colombia, Alaska, and Romania.

sum: This theoretical paper introduces a variational-adjoint interpretation of quantum mechanics, where the interaction between forward and adjoint wavefunctions defines a general Fréchet sensitivity kernel. This framework demonstrates that the Born probability density is a special, positive-definite case of these sensitivity kernels when the adjoint wavefunction is the complex conjugate of the forward wavefunction. The formulation extends to other quantum observables such as momentum, energy, and spin, framing them as Fréchet sensitivity kernels. This work bridges concepts from geophysical inverse theory (adjoint state methods, sensitivity kernels) with quantum mechanics, offering potential applications in quantum control, quantum metrology, and time-symmetric quantum interpretations.
本文提出量子力学的变分伴随解释，利用前向与伴随波函数的相互作用定义Fréchet敏感核。研究表明，波恩概率密度仅是伴随波函数为前向波函数共轭时的特例。该框架可推广至动量、能量和自旋等量子观测物理量，建立了地球物理反演（伴随状态法）与量子力学的理论联系，在量子控制和精密测量中具有应用前景。

sum: This study investigates the magmatic and thermal evolution of the subducting slab beneath the Aeolian arc. By analyzing geochemical and isotopic compositions of volcanic rocks from Stromboli volcano, the authors identify a distinct magmatic shift around 13,000 years ago, marked by the emergence of potassium-rich rocks indicating high-temperature sediment melting. This contrasts with older rocks (>13,000 years) that show no obvious melting, representing a cold subduction setting. The transition from cold-slab to hot-slab conditions is linked to asthenospheric mantle upwelling triggered by early Pleistocene slab tearing. This tectono-magmatic coupling explains the southeastward migration of potassium-rich volcanism across the Italian Peninsula, matching tomographic and topographic evidence of slab tearing. The findings demonstrate a rapid magmatic response (<1-2 million years) to mantle upwelling, offering new insights into recent volcanism in southeastern Italy.
本研究通过斯特龙博利火山岩的地球化学与同位素分析，揭示了伊奥利亚弧俯冲板块的热演化。约1.3万年前富钾岩石的出现标志着冷到热俯冲的转变，由早更新世板块撕裂引发的地幔上涌驱动。该机制解释了意大利半岛富钾火山活动的东南向迁移，表明岩浆对地幔上涌响应迅速，为该区火山活动提供了新见解。

t: Geochemical and isotopic analysis of volcanic rocks from Stromboli volcano to trace slab thermal transitions.
对斯特龙博利火山岩石进行地球化学和同位素分析，以追踪板块热演化。
Geochemical and isotopic data of potassium-rich and bulk sediment volcanic rocks from the Aeolian arc.
来自伊奥利亚弧的富钾及整体沉积物火山岩的地球化学与同位素数据。
Identification of a transition from cold-slab to hot-slab subduction since ~13,000 years ago, driven by early Pleistocene slab tearing and mantle upwelling.
发现自约1.3万年前起从冷板块向热板块的转变，由早更新世板块撕裂和地幔上涌驱动。

依赖间接的地球化学指标来推断深部地球动力学过程和板块撕裂历史。

sum: This study performs a joint inversion of S-wave travel times and Rayleigh-wave phase and group velocities using dense seismic array data to image subsurface fault structures beneath the Seoul metropolitan area down to 40 km depth. The resulting high-resolution velocity model reveals a shallow low-velocity anomaly along the Pocheon Fault and a deeper anomaly along the Wangsukcheon Fault extending into the upper mantle. It also identifies previously unrecognized fault extensions, associates a northern Seoul earthquake swarm with the Pocheon Fault's southwestward extension, and images the Gyeonggang Fault dipping at ~60° northwest. These findings provide critical constraints on intraplate fault geometry and seismic hazards in a densely populated urban region.

sum: This study presents an integrated, site-specific framework that couples 1D nonlinear free-field ground-response analysis with 3D soil-pile-bridge finite-element modeling. Applied to a pile-supported bridge in the liquefiable Adapazarı–Karasu corridor, Türkiye, the framework utilizes SPT and laboratory data from seven boreholes. An SPT-based simplified procedure quantifies liquefaction triggering, while 1D nonlinear analyses of seven spectrally matched ground motions provide free-field displacement demands. These demands are transferred into a 3D Mohr–Coulomb continuum model to evaluate seismic pile performance. Results show liquefaction-induced settlements up to 0.33 m and peak pile internal forces concentrating at the interface between stiff and liquefiable layers. The principal novelty lies in the direct coupling of deformation-controlled free-field demands with a 3D soil-structure-interaction model, offering a transferable methodology for assessing seismic ground response and pile-foundation performance in soft-soil basins.

sum: This paper presents a differential qualitative analysis of a laughter prescription intervention ('laughie') designed for earthquake survivors. The study investigates the psychological and well-being outcomes of using a structured laughter exercise to help survivors cope with trauma and stress following an earthquake. By analyzing qualitative feedback from participants, the researchers evaluate the feasibility, benefits, and limitations of this non-pharmacological intervention. The study contributes to disaster mental health and post-disaster psychological recovery strategies, though it does not contain any geophysics, seismology, or computational wave physics content.

sum: This study analyzes SO2 flux and gas composition during the 2021 flank eruption of Pacaya Volcano, Guatemala, using Tropomi satellite data, field UV cameras, and Multigas measurements. The results show a pre-eruptive rise in SO2 flux and distinct chemical differences between the central crater and flank fissure plumes, specifically CO2 depletion and H2O enrichment in the latter. These variations are explained by fractional degassing between a vertical conduit and a horizontal dyke diverging at 10–20 MPa, hydrothermal scrubbing of SO2, and groundwater incorporation into the magma dyke. This highlights the complex subsurface plumbing and volatile interactions during flank eruptions.

sum: This paper presents a training-free, data-driven method for structural damage localization using spatial-correlation sensor networks. By defining sensors as nodes and their spatial correlations as edges, the approach tracks changes relative to a baseline to localize damage without requiring explicit structural models, labeled training data, or expert-selected reference sensors. The method is validated using seismic response data from a full-scale seven-story reinforced-concrete building tested at UC San Diego across four progressive earthquake-induced damage states. The results show successful damage localization and sensor centrality identification, which helps select informative sensors for modal parameter extraction, offering a low-cost complement to traditional structural health monitoring.
本文提出了一种基于空间相关性传感器网络的免训练、数据驱动结构损伤定位方法。该方法将传感器视为节点，将它们之间的空间相关性定义为边，通过对比基线的相关性变化来定位损伤，无需显式结构模型或标注训练数据。该方法在加州大学圣地亚哥分校测试的七层钢筋混凝土剪力墙足尺建筑上进行了验证，涵盖了四种渐进式地震损伤状……

sum: This paper presents a PRISMA 2020 systematic review of 65 primary studies on sensor architectures for autonomous vehicles. It evaluates cameras, LiDAR, radar, thermal, and GNSS/IMU systems under various environmental conditions, concluding that no single modality is universally superior. The study proposes a reliability-aware architecture that decouples sensor health from task confidence to achieve graceful degradation.

sum: This paper introduces the Physical-Structure-Driven Waveform Inversion Imaging (PSDWII) framework, which conceptualizes seismic wave propagation as a three-step physical process involving subsurface virtual sources. By utilizing the adjoint of the propagation operator (reverse-time extrapolation), PSDWII establishes a linear inversion projection for these virtual sources. This approach unifies full-waveform inversion (FWI), stratigraphic physical properties imaging, and stratigraphic structures imaging without constructing objective functions or computing gradients and Hessian inverses. The framework introduces three specific methods: PSDFWI for multi-parameter decoupling, PSDSI for angle-domain common-image gather inversion, and PSDMig for structural imaging. PSDWII shifts the paradigm of waveform inversion from mathematical optimization to physical-structure-driven imaging.
本文提出物理结构驱动波形反演成像（PSDWII）框架。该框架将波传播分解为源激发、虚拟源产生和二次波传播，利用伴随算子构建虚拟源的线性反演。PSDWII统一了FWI、地层物性与结构成像，无需构建目标函数或计算梯度。基于此开发了PSDFWI、PSDSI和PSDMig方法，实现了从数学优化向物理驱动的反……

将波传播分解为三步，利用伴随算子构建地下虚拟源的线性反演投影。
Theoretical formulation and methodological development, typically evaluated using synthetic seismic reflection data.

Potential sensitivity to background model errors and performance under field data conditions are not detailed in the abstract.

Shifts the waveform inversion paradigm from mathematical optimization to physical-structure-driven imaging, bypassing objective functions and Hessian calculations.

sum: This article serves as the introduction to the BSSA Special Section on 'Advancing Physics-Based Ground-Motion Simulations for Seismic Hazard Applications.' It outlines the state-of-the-art in numerical wave propagation, source characterization, and site-response modeling. The collection of papers highlights the transition from empirical ground-motion models to fully physics-based 3D simulations, addressing key challenges such as high-frequency wave propagation, computational efficiency, and validation against observed data. It emphasizes the integration of these simulations into engineering practices and seismic hazard mitigation strategies.
本文是BSSA“推进地震危险性应用中基于物理的地面运动模拟”专题的引言。文章概述了数值波动传播、震源表征和场地响应建模的最新进展。该专题收录的文章展示了从经验地面运动模型向完全基于物理的三维模拟的转变，解决了高频波传播、计算效率以及观测数据验证等关键挑战，强调了将模拟融入工程实践与防震减灾中的重要性……

综述并综合了基于物理的地面运动模拟方法，包括确定性三维波传播和混合宽频技术。
Synthesized observations and simulated datasets from multiple studies featured in the special section.

Highlights the growing viability and accuracy of physics-based simulations for engineering and seismic hazard applications.

Provides a comprehensive, up-to-date editorial synthesis of the state-of-the-art in physics-based ground-motion modeling for 2026.
