sum: This study systematically evaluates the impact of input data representation on deep learning earthquake denoisers. The author designs and benchmarks four architectures: a time-domain model, a time-frequency model (EQS Denoiser), and two hybrid models (parallel and sequential). While time-domain models excel at high SNRs but fail at low SNRs, and time-frequency models capture low-SNR events but smear onsets, the hybrid sequential model (extending EQS) combines the strengths of both. It achieves superior waveform reconstruction, preserves sharp signal onsets, and improves downstream tasks like phase picking and first-motion polarity determination across both in-distribution and out-of-distribution datasets.
本研究评估了输入数据表征对深度学习地震去噪器的影响。作者对比了时域、时频域及两种混合（并行与序列）架构。时域模型在高信噪比下精确但低信噪比下失效；时频模型能捕获弱信号但会模糊初至。扩展EQS的混合序列模型结合了两者优势，在保持清晰初至的同时实现强低信噪比信号检测，显著提升了震相拾取和极性判定能力。

t: Four deep learning architectures (time, time-frequency, parallel hybrid, sequential hybrid) are designed and benchmarked to evaluate the impact of input data representation on seismic denoising.
设计并基准测试了四种深度学习架构（时域、时频域、并行混合、序列混合）以评估输入表征对去噪的影响。
In-distribution and out-of-distribution earthquake waveform datasets are used to evaluate denoising performance, waveform quality, and downstream tasks across various signal-to-noise ratios.
使用分布内和分布外地震波形数据集，在不同信噪比下评估去噪性能、波形质量及下游任务。

The hybrid sequential model outperforms other models, achieving strong signal detection at low SNRs while preserving sharp onsets, thereby improving phase picking and first-motion polarity determination.
混合序列模型表现最优，在低信噪比下实现强信号检测并保留清晰初至，提升了震相拾取和极性判定。
Time-domain models fail at low SNRs, while time-frequency models introduce artifacts like smeared onsets due to time-frequency binning.
时域模型在低信噪比下失效，而时频模型由于时频分箱会引入初至模糊等伪影。
First systematic assessment of input data representation (time vs. time-frequency vs. hybrid) for deep learning seismic denoisers under controlled conditions.
首次在受控条件下系统评估了深度学习地震去噪器中输入数据表征（时域、时频域与混合域）的影响。

Demonstrates improved performance in downstream tasks including phase picking and first-motion polarity determination.

sum: This paper addresses the challenge of predicting how chemical damage (debonding) affects the macroscopic elastic properties of cemented granular materials in underground reservoirs (e.g., CO2 storage, geothermal systems). The authors propose a Digital Rock Physics (DRP) approach to compare two microstructure modeling frameworks: a discrete description using a Discrete Element Model (DEM), and a continuous description combining a Phase-Field model for microstructural evolution with Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) for estimating macroscopic properties. Both frameworks are used to establish softening laws that describe material weathering, providing valuable constitutive models for reservoir geomechanics.
本文针对地下储层中化学损伤如何影响胶结颗粒材料宏观弹性性质的预测难题展开研究。作者提出一种数字岩石物理方法，对比了两种微观结构建模框架：基于离散元模型的离散描述，以及结合相场法与快速傅里叶变换的连续描述。这两种框架均用于建立描述材料风化的软化律，为储层地质力学提供了关键的本构模型。

t: A Digital Rock Physics approach comparing Discrete Element Method (DEM) and a continuous Phase-Field description combined with Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) homogenization.
对比离散元法（DEM）与结合快速傅里叶变换（FFT）均匀化的连续相场描述的数字岩石物理方法。
Synthetic microstructural models of cemented granular materials undergoing simulated chemical damage and debonding.
经历模拟化学损伤和脱粘的胶结颗粒材料的合成微观结构模型。
Establishment of distinct softening laws that predict the reduction of macroscopic elastic properties during chemical weathering.
建立了不同的软化律，用于预测化学风化过程中宏观弹性性质的降低。
The models are numerical and require experimental calibration to validate the predicted softening behavior under real chemical conditions.
模型为数值模型，需要实验校准以验证在真实化学条件下的预测软化行为。
Direct comparison between discrete (DEM) and continuous (Phase-Field + FFT) homogenization frameworks for modeling chemical damage in rocks.
直接对比了用于模拟岩石化学损伤的离散（DEM）和连续（相场+FFT）均匀化框架。

Establishes predictive softening laws to describe the evolution of macroscopic elastic properties during weathering.

建立了预测性软化律，以描述风化过程中宏观弹性性质的演化。

sum: This study evaluates sterane and hopane thermal maturity parameters in bituminous mirror-like surfaces (MSs) to distinguish seismic (rapid heating) from aseismic (negligible heating) fault slip. Analyzing natural faults from the Central Apennines and experimental MSs sheared at seismic (1-3 m/s) and sub-seismic (0.0001 m/s) rates, the authors found higher thermal maturity in seismic MSs compared to their slip zones. Static heating experiments showed that while biomarker concentrations change within 30 seconds, over 60 seconds of heating is required to alter sterane 20S and hopane 22S ratios. This demonstrates that rapid frictional heating during earthquakes locally alters biomarkers, providing a novel proxy to identify ancient seismic slip on mirror-like fault surfaces.
本研究通过测量沥青断层镜面（MSs）中的甾烷和藿烷热成熟度参数，以区分地震（快速升温）与抗震（温升微弱）断层滑动。研究分析了意大利中亚平宁山脉的天然断层及在不同剪切速率（1-3 m/s 和 0.0001 m/s）下模拟的实验断层镜面。结果表明，地震滑动的断层镜面其热成熟度显著高于其滑移带。静态加热实……

t: Organic geochemistry analysis of sterane and hopane biomarkers combined with high-velocity rotary-shear friction experiments and static heating tests.
结合高频旋转剪切摩擦实验、静态加热测试以及甾烷和藿烷生物标志物的有机地球化学分析。
Natural mirror-like fault surfaces from bituminous dolostones in the Central Apennines, Italy, alongside experimentally sheared and statically heated bituminous samples.
采集自意大利中亚平宁山脉含沥青白云岩的天然断层镜面，以及经实验剪切和静态加热的沥青样品。
Seismic slip and heating >60 seconds increase sterane 20S and hopane 22S maturity parameters, distinguishing seismic mirror-like surfaces from aseismic ones.
地震滑动和大于60秒的加热提高了甾烷20S和藿烷22S成熟度参数，从而将地震断层镜面与抗震断层镜面区分开。
The method is restricted to faults hosted in organic-rich or bituminous rocks and requires sufficient heating duration to alter specific maturity ratios.
该方法仅适用于富含有机质或沥青的断层，且需要足够的加热时间才能改变特定的成熟度比例。
First application of sterane and hopane biomarker thermal maturity parameters to differentiate seismic from aseismic slip on mirror-like fault surfaces.
首次应用甾烷和藿烷生物标志物热成熟度参数来区分断层镜面上的地震与抗震滑动。

kc: Demonstrated that sterane and hopane thermal maturity parameters can distinguish seismic from aseismic slip on mirror-like fault surfaces.
Combined natural fault observations with rotary-shear friction experiments and static heating tests to calibrate biomarker response.
Showed that rapid frictional heating during earthquakes locally alters biomarkers, establishing a novel paleoseismological proxy.
证实了甾烷和藿烷热成熟度参数可以区分断层镜面上的地震与抗震滑动。

me: Organic geochemistry analysis of sterane and hopane biomarkers in bitumen.
High-velocity rotary-shear friction experiments to generate experimental mirror-like surfaces at seismic (1-3 m/s) and sub-seismic (0.0001 m/s) slip rates.
Static heating experiments of bituminous powders at 400 °C for durations ranging from 2 seconds to 12 hours.
沥青中甾烷和藿烷生物标志物的有机地球化学分析。

在400 °C下对沥青粉末进行持续2秒至12小时的静态加热实验。

Experimental mirror-like surfaces generated under controlled slip rates.
Biomarker concentration and maturity ratio measurements (sterane 20S and hopane 22S).
采集自意大利中亚平宁山脉含沥青白云岩的具有镜面的天然断层样品。
在受控滑动速率下生成的实验断层镜面。
生物标志物浓度和成熟度比例测量（甾烷 20S 和藿烷 22S）。

sum: This study investigates the tectonic and climatic drivers of uplift in the Nahuelbuta Range, Northern Patagonian Andes, using geomorphic mapping, morphometric drainage analysis, and river-inversion modeling. The authors identify a warped, low-relief relic landscape atop the range that was abandoned between 3 Ma and 2.5 Ma, marking the onset of rapid uplift. River-inversion modeling reveals three discrete uplift pulses during the Quaternary, which correlate with Late Cenozoic glacial expansions. These pulses, combined with drainage anomalies and microseismicity aligning with trench-perpendicular faults, suggest that glacially-driven tectonic underplating (basal accretion) in the sediment-rich subduction channel, alongside ongoing trench-parallel shortening, controls the episodic uplift and deformation of the forearc. The findings link surface landscape evolution directly to deep-seated subduction processes and climate-tectonic feedbacks.
本研究结合地貌制图、水系形态分析和河流反演模拟，探讨了安第斯山北巴塔哥尼亚纳韦尔布塔前弧隆起的构造与气候控制机制。研究识别出山顶一处在3.0-2.5 Ma废弃的弯曲低起伏残留景观，标志着快速抬升的开始。河流反演模拟重建出第四纪三次离散的抬升脉冲，其时间与晚新生代冰川扩张相吻合。水系异常和微震活动沿走……

t: Combines surface geomorphic mapping, morphometric drainage analysis, and river-inversion modeling to reconstruct the spatial and temporal history of tectonic uplift.
结合地貌制图、水系形态分析和河流反演模拟，重建构造抬升的时空演化历史。
Topographic elevation data (DEMs) for river profile extraction, along with microseismicity catalogs and seismic imaging of the subduction channel.
用于提取河流剖面的地形高程数据（DEM），以及微震目录和俯冲通道的地震成像数据。
Identifies three discrete Quaternary uplift pulses since 3 Ma correlating with glacial expansions, and active trench-parallel shortening along trench-perpendicular faults.
识别出3 Ma以来与冰川扩张相关的三次第四纪抬升脉冲，以及沿垂直海沟断层的活动海沟平行缩短。
Resolution of older uplift history is limited by dense vegetation, weathering, and simplified assumptions in river-incision modeling.
受茂密植被、风化作用以及河流侵蚀模型简化假设的限制，更早期的抬升历史分辨率有限。
First to quantify episodic Quaternary uplift transients in the Nahuelbuta Range and link them directly to glacially-modulated tectonic underplating.
首次量化了纳韦尔布塔前弧的第四纪阶段性抬升脉冲，并将其与冰川调节的构造底贴直接联系起来。

kc: Identified a warped, low-relief relic landscape atop the Nahuelbuta Range abandoned between 3 Ma and 2.5 Ma, constraining the onset of rapid uplift.

sum: This paper presents a multi-constraint evaluation of the traditional slab-pull hypothesis, which assumes that the negative buoyancy of subducting slabs drives plate motion via long-range tensile forces. By analyzing six independent constraints—including atomic-scale physics, asthenospheric rheology, subduction kinematics, and deep-focus earthquakes—the author argues that ultra-high lithostatic pressure prevents long-term stable tensile stress. Instead, the paper proposes that horizontal tectonic compressive forces from mid-ocean ridges offer a more physically consistent dynamic framework for plate tectonics.

sum: This study investigates the drivers of Himalayan topography in Nepal using linked numerical models of fault activity, paleoclimate (precipitation), and surface processes over geological timescales. Rather than relying on steady-state continuum wedge models, the authors simulate discrete, large-offset faulting and paleoclimate histories. They identify two distinct topography-generating mechanisms: lateral translation of uplifted topography during active foreland faulting, and deep river incision into the hinterland during periods of active hinterland faulting combined with foreland quiescence. Alternating between these two tectonic modes explains the first-order regional catchment geometries and physiography of the modern Himalaya. The novelty lies in demonstrating that discrete fault dynamics, rather than continuous deformation, are essential to replicating observed mountain topography and river network structures.

sum: This study presents a high-resolution seismic tomographic model of the Central American subduction zone using a joint inversion of local body-wave and teleseismic Rayleigh-wave data. The model reveals significant along-trench structural heterogeneities in the crust and upper mantle that correlate with the segmentation of forearc megathrust earthquakes and arc volcanism. Large earthquakes (Mw ≥ 7.0) cluster above subslab low-velocity anomalies, suggesting buoyant asthenosphere accumulation influences megathrust segmentation. Active volcanoes align with low-velocity anomalies in the crust and mantle wedge, indicating localized partial melting. Additionally, slab rollback beneath Nicaragua and toroidal mantle flow beneath Costa Rica explain along-arc geochemical variations. The novelty lies in using joint body- and surface-wave tomography to link deep slab/mantle dynamics directly to the spatial segmentation of both seismicity and volcanism.

sum: This study investigates the origin of deep long-period (DLP) earthquakes beneath volcanoes along the Alaska-Aleutian arc by combining 34 years of seismic catalog data (1989–2023) with geochemical constraints from 22 volcanoes. The authors find that DLPs are most frequent at depths of 10–25 km and ~32 km below sea level, corresponding to the onset of crystallization and near-Moho volatile saturation, respectively. Using melt inclusion volatile data and solubility modeling, they show that the CO2 concentrations required to initiate exsolution at DLP depths align with or exceed parental CO2 estimates. The results suggest that near-Moho DLPs are driven by first boiling during magma ascent, while shallower crustal DLPs are linked to magma stalling and second boiling. This provides a comprehensive framework linking deep volcanic seismicity to volatile migration.

sum: This study reconstructs the tectonic and source-to-sink evolution of the Lorca and Sorbas-Vera basins in the Eastern Betics from 15 to 4 Ma, spanning a major slab tearing interval. By combining structural analysis with detrital zircon U-Pb dating of basement units and basin fill, the authors show how upper-crustal extension directions shifted repeatedly in response to migrating dynamic topography and mantle upwelling. Pre-slab-tearing NW-SE extension (15–10.5 Ma) transitioned to NE-SW extension during slab tearing (10.5–7 Ma), accompanied by maximum subsidence and magmatism. Post-slab-tearing flexural rebound and mantle upwelling drove topographic uplift, reversing sediment routing. This work highlights the profound impact of deep lithospheric processes, such as slab tearing and delamination, on surface topography, drainage networks, and basin sedimentation.

sum: This study evaluates the applicability of various ground-motion models (GMMs) for probabilistic seismic hazard assessment (PSHA) in the French Lesser Antilles. Utilizing a newly compiled, high-quality regional strong-motion database, the authors perform a comprehensive analysis of observed ground motions against model predictions. The research addresses the critical need for region-specific hazard characterization in active subduction zones, providing insights into which GMMs best capture the attenuation and site effects characteristic of the Lesser Antilles arc. The findings help reduce epistemic uncertainty in seismic hazard maps for the region, contributing to improved building codes and risk mitigation strategies.

sum: This paper develops a theoretical model to determine the radial profile of the mean velocity in a coherent geostrophic vortex within a rapidly rotating turbulent fluid. The authors propose that the vortex flow is sustained by the absorption of short-wavelength inertial waves traveling from the periphery, assuming negligible nonlinear wave-wave interactions. The theoretical predictions are validated by comparison with experimental data, demonstrating the model's capability to describe the maintenance of columnar vortices in rotational turbulence.

sum: This study presents a multiscale shear-wave velocity model of the Bhutan Himalaya crust down to ~50 km depth using surface wave dispersion from ambient noise and teleseismic Rayleigh waves recorded by the GANSSER network. The model reveals significant lateral heterogeneity in the upper crust and images the Main Himalayan Thrust (MHT) as a continuous low-velocity layer. The MHT exhibits a flat-ramp geometry, with a ramp emerging at ~10 km depth in western Bhutan and dipping to ~20 km in eastern Bhutan. In central Bhutan, a disruption of this low-velocity layer and a concave-upward lower-crustal anomaly suggest a potential crustal tear or segmentation of the thrust system, providing critical insights into the regional deformation and seismic hazard.

sum: This study investigates the 2023 Târgu Jiu seismic sequence in Romania, which began with two moderate mainshocks (Mw 4.9 and Mw 5.4) at ~20 km depth. By combining relocated hypocenters, focal mechanisms, waveform inversion, and self-similar dynamic rupture modeling, the authors characterize the fault geometry and rupture process. The results suggest predominantly unilateral upward rupture propagation toward the northwest along a southeast-dipping normal fault. The modeled stress drops are 3.6 MPa (Mw 4.9) and 4.7 MPa (Mw 5.4), with source durations of 1.3 s and 2.0 s, respectively. Heterogeneous slip is concentrated near the nucleation area, with peak slips of 0.05 m and 0.12 m. The spatial distribution of over 4,400 aftershocks highlights the influence of complex pre-existing crustal structures and potential fluid-driven processes on rupture propagation.

sum: This study investigates the evolution of magma permeability during the viscous-brittle transition using uniaxial compression experiments on rhyolite lava from Niijima Island, Japan. Experiments were conducted at 806–955 °C and strain rates of 10^-6.5 to 10^-1.3 s^-1. Results show that under viscous deformation (Weissenberg number Wi < 10^-3.4), permeability remains stable or decreases slightly at high strain. Conversely, under brittle deformation (Wi > 10^-2.5), permeability increases by up to two orders of magnitude due to the formation and widening of large cracks. This suggests that efficient outgassing occurs in high-Wi regions (shallow/outer conduit parts), leading to a zoned conduit structure with a highly permeable brittle plug overlying viscous vesicular magma.

sum: This paper investigates the storm-to-storm variability and interhemispheric asymmetries in magnetosphere-ionosphere (MI) coupling during the extreme (G5) geomagnetic storm of May 10-11, 2024, and the severe (G4) storm of October 10-11, 2024. Utilizing global field-aligned current (FAC) data from AMPERE, ground-based magnetometer observations from SuperMAG, and GPS-derived total electron content (TEC), the authors analyze high-latitude electrodynamic and ionospheric responses. The May storm showed relatively organized, conjugate FAC systems and structured TEC enhancements with temporal offsets. Conversely, the October storm exhibited highly localized, asymmetric FAC morphology and spatially heterogeneous TEC variability. These findings demonstrate that even under strong solar wind driving, the coupled MI system can display highly distinct spatial organization and interhemispheric coupling, driven by FAC morphology, ionospheric conductance, and local electrodynamics.

sum: This study uses 2D physics-based earthquake sequence simulations, constrained by laboratory experiments and seismological observations, to investigate induced seismicity in the Groningen gas field. The authors analyze how fault offset, stratigraphic layering, lithology-dependent elastic and frictional properties, and fault healing govern rupture characteristics. They find that earthquake nucleation consistently occurs within the Slochteren sandstone reservoir. Heterogeneous elastic parameters exert a dominant control on rupture behavior, suppressing slip rates and limiting rupture extent, whereas heterogeneous friction has a minor effect. Runaway rupture into the underburden is exceptionally rare (occurring in <0.1% of simulations). Mapping these outcomes onto the Groningen fault network indicates that 99% of fault segments have a very low probability of propagating beyond the reservoir thickness. This demonstrates that lithological heterogeneity imposes strong physical constraints on rupture extent, providing physics-based limits on maximum magnitude ($M_{max}$) for hazard assessment.

sum: This paper introduces a novel modeling strategy for developing ground motion prediction equations (GMPEs) by incorporating relative importance analysis. Traditional GMPE development often struggles with selecting and weighting predictor variables objectively. By evaluating the relative contribution of different seismic parameters (such as magnitude, distance, and site conditions) to ground motion intensity measures, the proposed method systematically optimizes the functional form of GMPEs. This approach enhances the stability and predictive accuracy of the empirical models, providing a more robust framework for seismic hazard assessment and engineering applications.

sum: This paper presents a multisensor seismic experiment in the Cook Inlet segment of the Alaska-Aleutian subduction zone, combining 11 onshore broadband seismographs with an offshore distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) campaign on fiber-optic cables. The deployment aims to investigate the subduction interface's structure and properties to understand slip, tremor, and plate locking. The combined dataset successfully records local earthquakes, teleseismic waves, and environmental/oceanographic noise. Despite high noise levels from the basin and indoor deployment sites, the DAS data provides detailed insights into oceanographic processes in the inlet. This integrated onshore-offshore approach bridges the gap between environmental forcing and seismic response, offering a novel dataset for subduction zone imaging and environmental seismology.
本文介绍在阿拉斯加库克湾俯冲带开展的陆海联合地震观测实验。该实验结合了11个陆地宽频带台站与近海光缆分布式声学传感（DAS）技术。联合数据集成功记录了本地地震、远震及环境噪声。DAS数据揭示了丰富的海洋动力学过程。该研究展示了多传感器联合观测在探测俯冲带结构及桥接陆海环境信号方面的独特优势。

sum: This study investigates the February 2025 earthquake sequence in the Santorini-Amorgos basins, South-Central Aegean Sea. By relocating 4,869 earthquakes and performing full moment-tensor (MT) inversions for 30 events (Mw >= 4.5), the authors map the spatio-temporal migration of seismicity from volcanic centers northeastward. Stress tensor inversion reveals a dominant NW-SE extensional regime. The MT solutions show normal, oblique-normal, and strike-slip mechanisms with significant non-double-couple (non-DC) components. These non-DC signatures indicate tensile crack-opening processes driven by magma intrusion or fluid migration at shallow crustal depths (5-15 km). The findings highlight the interplay between regional extensional tectonics and active magmatism in the Aegean back-arc.

sum: This study investigates the three-dimensional basin-mountain coupling effects on ground motion amplification in sedimentary basins. By analyzing the interaction between complex topography (mountains) and sedimentary structures (basins), the authors demonstrate how coupling effects alter seismic wave propagation and amplify ground motion. The study utilizes numerical wave propagation modeling alongside real ground-motion records to validate the findings. The results highlight that ignoring mountain-basin interactions can lead to underestimating seismic hazards in basin areas adjacent to prominent topography, providing crucial insights for urban seismic microzonation and engineering design.

sum: This paper addresses the limitations of model-centric benchmark accuracy in evaluating AI reliability for critical industrial domains, such as subsurface exploration, healthcare, and energy grids. The authors propose a conceptual framework based on 'structural alignment' across four interacting domains: the physical, representational, machine, and human cognitive worlds. These worlds are linked via digitalization and goal encoding interfaces. The framework characterizes the solution space using existence, non-uniqueness, robustness, and interpretability. By analyzing how mismatches propagate across these interfaces, the paper provides a systematic way to diagnose reliability failures, highlighting non-uniqueness as a primary challenge in subsurface geophysics.
本文针对地球物理勘探、医疗和能源电网等关键工业领域中，传统以模型为中心的基准精度无法评估AI可靠性的问题，提出了一种“结构对齐”概念框架。该框架涵盖四个相互作用的世界：物理、表征、机器和人类认知世界，并通过数字化和目标编码两个接口进行连接。作者通过存在性、非唯一性、鲁棒性和可解释性四个属性来表征解空……

sum: This study investigates the 3D geodynamic viability and tectonic responses of subduction polarity reversal (SPR) propagation during arc-continent collision. Using 3D numerical modeling and systematic parameter testing, the authors demonstrate that SPR propagation is highly dependent on the thermal age and rheological strength of the subducting lithosphere. Specifically, SPR propagation only occurs when the lithosphere is thermally aged and rheologically strong. Conversely, young or rheologically weak lithosphere leads to slab tearing or break-off, which halts the propagation. These findings provide critical geodynamic insights into the initiation of the Vitiaz and Andaman-Sumatra trenches, as well as the occurrence of slab tearing in the Philippine and Vanuatu subduction zones.
本研究利用三维数值模拟探讨了弧-陆碰撞背景下俯冲极性反转（SPR）传播的地球动力学可行性与构造响应。系统参数测试表明，SPR的传播高度依赖于俯冲岩石圈的热年龄和流变强度：只有当岩石圈热老化且流变强度较高时，SPR才能顺利传播；而年轻或流变较弱的岩石圈则会导致板块撕裂或断裂，从而中断SPR传播。该成果……

sum: This paper presents a combined adjustment model to address long-wavelength errors in InSAR deformation measurements when integrating them with GNSS data for 3D deformation estimation. By introducing systematic parameters for InSAR long-wavelength errors, defining them with GNSS minimum constraints, and optimizing the stochastic model using least-squares variance component estimation (LS-VCE), the method prevents these errors from biasing 3D displacement fields. Synthetic tests demonstrate a reduction in datum deviation to below 1 mm. When applied to the 2011 Tohoku-Oki earthquake, the model significantly reduces mean absolute errors in East, North, and Up components compared to conventional geometric and strain models, and successfully recovers candidate strike-slip components.
本文提出了一种联合平差模型，用于解决在整合GNSS和InSAR数据进行三维形变估计时InSAR的长波段误差问题。该方法通过引入系统参数表征InSAR长波段误差，利用GNSS最小约束对其进行定义，并采用最小二乘方差分量估计（LS-VCE）优化随机模型。合成测试表明，该模型将基准偏差控制在1 mm以下。……

Synthetic datasets and real-world GNSS and InSAR observations of the 2011 Tohoku-Oki earthquake, validated against the JPL co-seismic displacement solution.

sum: This study constructs a detailed seismic crustal stratigraphy of Mars from the Cerberus Fossae source region of marsquake S0235b to the InSight landing site. By combining seismic waveforms from event S0235b and receiver functions from four quality-A marsquakes, the authors resolve a four-layer crustal model at the landing site and a three-layer model at the source side. A key novelty is the discovery of a low-velocity layer sandwiched between high-velocity layers on both sides (at 2.7–4.3 km depth on the source side and 3.9–6.2 km depth on the landing site), exhibiting strong negative SH-SV shear-wave anisotropy (-16% and -18%, respectively). The crust-mantle boundary is placed at 29.5 km (source) and 23.0 km (landing site). Synthetic tests confirm that these features and both P- and S-wave velocities are well resolved by the waveform data.

sum: This study presents 3D dynamic rupture simulations to investigate the physical mechanisms controlling earthquake rupture jumps across normal-fault stepovers. By systematically varying prestress, principal stress orientation, and fault geometry (gap and overlap distances), the authors identify key factors enabling jumps up to 5 km. They reveal a fundamental trade-off: closely spaced faults enhance jump potential but limit earthquake magnitude due to stress-shadowing. The largest magnitudes occur when the receiver fault lies on the hanging wall of the emitter fault at specific configurations. Crucially, the study demonstrates that static Coulomb stress change approaches fail to fully capture these dynamic rupture complexities, as dynamic jumping is rarer than static criteria predict. This work enhances seismic hazard assessment for normal-fault systems.
本研究利用三维动态破裂模拟，探讨了正断层阶区地震破裂跳跃的物理机制。通过改变应力与断层几何，发现破裂最大可跳跃5公里。紧密相邻断层虽易于跳跃，但应力遮蔽会限制震级。最大震级发生于接收断层位于发射断层上盘的特定配置。动态模拟表明，实际破裂跳跃比静态库仑应力准则预测的更罕见，对正断层地震危险性评估具有重……

sum: This paper introduces the 'structure-driven methodology' as an emerging cross-domain paradigm, contrasting it with the classical objective-driven iterative search paradigm. Drawing from number theory, physics, and the author's extensive experience in geophysical inversion, the paper establishes the Structure-Driven Inversion (SDI) framework, which includes Mathematical Structure-Driven Inversion (MSDI) and Physical Structure-Driven Inversion (PSDI). Instead of iteratively minimizing a misfit function, SDI advocates identifying and exploiting the intrinsic mathematical and physical structures of the inverse problem to directly construct the solution. This paradigm shift aims to improve computational efficiency and deepen cognitive understanding of complex inverse problems, offering a complementary direct strategy to traditional search-based optimization methods.

sum: RiptideRemix is an interactive dashboard developed during the 2025 Ocean Hack Week to synthesize marine acoustic and geophysical data into musical compositions. It integrates pre-processed audio clips from major repositories, including Ocean Networks Canada (ONC), SAGE, OrcaSound, and NCEI. Users can manipulate pitch, speed, and repetition in a visual audio mixer to create 'songs' while viewing corresponding waveforms and spectrograms. The tool serves an educational purpose by providing detailed descriptions of sensors, environments, and seismic wave characteristics, bridging data science, acoustic processing, and public outreach.

sum: This study investigates the 2018–2024 interseismic period in the Northern and Central Apennines, Italy, to understand long-term seismogenic behavior. By relocating the earthquake catalog and applying a declustering algorithm, the authors identify background seismicity and earthquake clusters. They find that background seismicity is concentrated in a 2-3 km thick low-angle layer, and most clusters are driven by aseismic processes. The depth of the seismicity layer increases, while cluster volume decreases, toward the southeast. Comparing the 2011–2016 and 2018–2024 interseismic phases reveals persistent spatial patterns and repeating swarm-like behaviors. The L'Aquila region remains seismically quiet compared to northern segments. These variations suggest that structural inheritance and upper crustal rheology control active deformation during interseismic periods.
本文研究了意大利南北亚平宁山脉2018-2024年间的地震间歇期特征。通过对地震目录进行重定位和群集划分，发现背景地震活动集中在2-3千米厚的低角度层中，且多数群集由无震滑动驱动。向东南方向，地震层深度增加而群集总体积减小，拉奎拉地区在两个间歇期（2011-2016和2018-2024）均表现出相对……

sum: To overcome the poor spatial resolution of volcanic tremor localization caused by sparse networks and complex wavefields, this paper proposes a maximum likelihood estimation (MLE)-based iterative peeling interferometric imaging method. The approach combines the noise robustness of interferometry with an iterative deblurring framework. By constructing data-driven empirical wavelets and updating an adaptive whitening filter via the Sherman-Morrison formula, it sequentially removes source responses from the residual wavefield, suppressing sidelobe interference. Synthetic and field applications to the 2011 Katla volcano tremor data demonstrate that the method achieves high-resolution source localization consistent with known ice cauldrons, even under adverse array geometries and multi-source interference.

t: An MLE-based iterative peeling interferometric imaging method that uses data-driven empirical wavelets and an adaptive whitening filter to sequentially strip source responses.

Synthetic datasets modeled after the Katla volcano scenario and field passive seismic data recording the 2011 Katla volcanic tremor.

sum: This paper presents a program-based synthesis of six publications investigating precursor fatigue damage in carbon fiber-reinforced polymer (CFRP) composites. By utilizing guided coda waves, nonlinear guided waves, high-frequency pulse-echo ultrasonics, and scanning acoustic microscopy, the study evaluates microstructural degradation before visible delamination occurs. Key findings show that coda-wave interferometry detects progressive propagation changes while first-arriving packets remain unchanged. Additionally, the guided-wave nonlinear response decreased by up to 26.8% during an 8-hour unloaded period, highlighting the importance of controlling post-loading measurement time. Although providing laboratory-scale sensitivity, the framework does not yet reliably predict residual strength or remaining life due to small specimen sizes and lack of independent statistical replication.
本文综合了六篇关于碳纤维复合材料早期疲劳损伤的研究。利用导波尾波、非线性导波及声学显微镜评估微结构退化。结果表明，尾波干涉能检测到渐进传播变化，而非线性响应在卸载8小时内下降达26.8%，强调了控制加载后测量时间的重要性。该方法展示了高敏感性，但因样本量小尚无法可靠预测剩余寿命。

Small specimen groups lack independent statistical replication, preventing reliable prediction of residual strength or remaining fatigue life.

sum: This study utilizes micropillar compression to investigate crystal plastic deformation in anorthite (plagioclase), which controls crustal rheology but is difficult to study under standard laboratory conditions due to brittle failure. By milling ~1 μm diameter pillars from single crystals and deforming them at 25, 300, and 800 °C, the authors quantify the critical resolved shear stress (CRSS) for pericline twinning (~300 MPa) and various slip systems. They find that twinning is temperature-insensitive and the easiest deformation mechanism, followed by slip on (011)[100], while slip on (011)[0-11] or (0-11)[011] is the hardest. This provides key quantitative constraints on plagioclase plasticity for crustal geodynamics.
本研究利用微柱压缩技术定量分析了钙长石的晶体塑性变形。研究者在25、300和800 °C下对约1微米直径的单晶微柱进行单轴压缩，测得机械双晶的临界分剪应力约为300 MPa且对温度不敏感。在各变形机制中，双晶最易发生，其次是(011)[100]滑移，而(011)[0-11]滑移最难激活。该工作为地壳……

Uniaxial compression data from 36 anorthite micropillars deformed at constant strain rates under temperatures of 25, 300, and 800 °C.

Critical resolved shear stress for pericline twinning is ~300 MPa (temperature-insensitive); slip on (011)[100] is the easiest slip system, while slip on (011)[0-11] or (0-11)[011] is the hardest.

sum: This study investigates the 2021-ongoing hydrothermal unrest at La Fossa Caldera (Vulcano Island, Italy) by analyzing the microstructural and mechanical properties of subsurface volcanic rocks. Combining borehole stratigraphy, high-resolution X-ray microtomography (micro-CT), petrophysical measurements, and in-situ uniaxial mechanical testing, the authors identify a highly porous scoriaceous horizon at ~615–655 m depth acting as a hydrothermal reservoir. This reservoir is sealed by surrounding low-porosity, mechanically competent lava units. This configuration allows fluid overpressure to build up to levels comparable to the tensile strength of the overlying rocks, promoting fracturing and episodic gas release without requiring shallow magma intrusion. The study provides a physical framework linking laboratory rock properties to geophysical monitoring data.

sum: This study performs 3D spectral-element simulations of seismic wave propagation in the Swiss Rhône Valley to investigate the impact of realistic Alpine topography on ground motion. By comparing topographic and flat-surface models for three local earthquakes, the authors identify a systematic component asymmetry: mountain sites experience horizontal deamplification (median 0.80–0.97× at 0.05–0.50 Hz) but consistent vertical amplification (1.16–2.32×). This asymmetry is attributed to topography-induced mode conversion and constructive interference from Alpine ridge geometry. The study highlights that sparse observational networks may fail to capture these complex 3D effects, demonstrating the value of physics-based simulations with uniform synthetic grids for seismic hazard assessment.

sum: This study investigates a Mw 4.6 earthquake sequence on November 27, 2013, in the western Sea of Marmara along the North Anatolian Fault (NAF). Using onshore and offshore seismic, geodetic, and pore pressure data, the authors identify a sequence of highly similar repeating earthquakes (multiplets) preceding the mainshock. This seismicity coincided with a months-long slow-slip event (SSE) propagating westward at ~0.5 km/day. Although Coulomb stress modeling shows only a minor stress increase (a few tenths of kPa) at the mainshock location due to the SSE, the temporal correlation between the SSE, multiplet-mainshock sequence, and pore pressure drops suggests complex hydromechanical coupling. The study highlights the importance of multi-disciplinary offshore and onshore monitoring to understand the interplay between seismic deformation, aseismic creep, and fluid migration in active fault zones.

sum: This study integrates 2D and 3D seismic surveys with well data across 35,000 km2 to reconstruct the Pennsylvanian to Early Triassic tectono-stratigraphic evolution of the Loppa High in the southwestern Barents Shelf. By mapping eight regional horizons and over 150 faults, the authors identify three discrete extensional fault systems: a Carboniferous ENE-WSW system, a Pennsylvanian-early Permian NNE-SSW system, and a late Permian-Early Triassic N-S system. These systems controlled depositional architecture, carbonate/evaporite distribution, and subsequent rift reorganization. The findings highlight how structural inheritance influenced the later opening of the Norwegian-Greenland Sea.

sum: This study addresses the challenge of estimating statistical properties of spatial geophysical fields under irregular and incomplete sampling. The authors develop an asymptotically unbiased spectral maximum-likelihood estimation (MLE) method that incorporates discrete spatial sampling patterns and provides analytical uncertainty calculations. Through asymptotic analysis and synthetic/real-world examples, they demonstrate that a growing-domain sampling strategy reduces estimator bias and variance more effectively than an infill (densifying) scheme. They also evaluate the Matérn covariance class and propose goodness-of-fit tests to detect deviations from Gaussianity, stationarity, and isotropy, offering a robust framework for spatial data analysis in Earth sciences.

sum: This paper addresses the physical origin and detection of foreshocks by examining declustering algorithms. The authors compare the classical nearest-neighbor (NN) declustering metric with a newly proposed reverse nearest-neighbor (rNN) metric, which scales the correlation metric with the magnitude of the later event rather than the earlier one. Using synthetic catalogs generated from ETAS (purely bottom-up triggering) and ETAFS (mixed preparatory-triggering) models, they demonstrate that rNN is mathematically equivalent to applying NN to a time-reversed catalog. The study reveals how standard NN methods systematically underestimate foreshocks due to scaling asymmetries, providing a symmetric framework to better evaluate foreshock rates and physical triggering mechanisms.
本文探讨前震的物理起源与检测。作者对比了经典最近邻（NN）与新提出的反向最近邻（rNN）去群集指标（根据后发事件震级缩放）。通过ETAS和ETAFS模型合成编目，证明rNN在数学上等价于对时间反转编目应用标准NN。研究揭示了标准NN方法因尺度不对称性会系统性低估前震，为评估前震率提供了对称的分析框架……

sum: This study uses magnetotelluric (MT) sounding to image the crust-mantle resistivity structure across the West Qinling orogenic belt in the northeastern Tibetan Plateau. The resulting electrical resistivity model provides insights into the deep lithospheric structure, identifying high-conductivity zones in the crust and upper mantle. These conductive features are interpreted as indicators of partial melting or fluid pathways, which played a crucial role in the genesis and ascent of Indosinian granitoids. The findings help constrain the tectonic evolution and magmatic processes of the West Qinling orogen during the Indosinian period.
本研究利用大地电磁（MT）测深技术成像了青藏高原东北缘西秦岭造山带的壳幔电阻率结构。所得电阻率模型揭示了深部岩石圈结构，识别出中下地壳及上地幔存在显著的高导（低阻）异常区。这些高导特征被解释为地壳部分熔融或流体通道的指示，在印支期花岗岩的成因与运移上升过程中起到了关键作用。研究结果为理解西秦岭造山带……

Broadband and long-period magnetotelluric data collected along a profile crossing the West Qinling orogenic belt.

sum: This study investigates the impact of slab folding on the topographic evolution of collisional orogens and sediment supply to associated basins under varying erosion and sedimentation rates. Using numerical geodynamic simulations, the authors demonstrate that slab-folding-induced steepening enhances topographic growth (0.008–0.310 mm/yr) and increases sediment thickness. Crucially, the spatial and temporal scale of deformation is modulated by sediment load: high sedimentation rates (≥0.3 mm/yr) promote regional lithospheric extension in the basin, whereas lower rates (<0.3 mm/yr) enhance localized tectonic subsidence along normal faults. This work highlights the complex feedback between surface processes (erosion/sedimentation) and deep lithospheric dynamics during ribbon collision.
本文利用数值模拟研究了不同剥蚀和沉积速率下，板块折叠对碰撞造山带地形演化及盆地沉积物供应的影响。研究表明，板块折叠引起的俯冲板块变陡促进了造山带地形生长（速率达0.008-0.310 mm/yr）并增加了沉积厚度。创新性的是，沉积载荷在两个时空尺度上影响变形：高沉积速率（≥0.3 mm/yr）促进盆……

sum: This paper evaluates ensemble forecasts from ECMWF's physical Integrated Forecasting System (IFS) and the Artificial Intelligence Forecasting System (AIFS-ENS) using a multi-dimensional phase-space framework. By treating ensemble uncertainty as a linear subspace, the authors extract geometric properties and compute principal angles to compare the error-representation patterns. The analysis reveals that while both models show similar capabilities in representing error amplitude and structure, their ensemble subspaces do not entirely overlap, and both are highly dependent on the number of ensemble members.

sum: This Zenodo repository contains the data products associated with the manuscript 'Global terrain correction of continental heat flow with a neural-operator surrogate of three-dimensional heat-conduction simulations'. It includes per-site terrain corrections for continental heat flow, a global transfer-factor field, and a trained neural operator. The neural operator serves as a highly efficient surrogate model for computationally expensive three-dimensional heat-conduction simulations, enabling rapid and accurate terrain corrections of heat flow measurements on a global scale.

sum: This study analyzes the farside marsquake S0976a detected by the InSight mission, locating it in the Valles Marineris region. The event involved strike-slip faulting in the deep crust. By inferring the stress orientation from the focal mechanism, the authors show that the contemporary stress field—driven by planetary cooling, regional Tharsis loading, and local erosion-related unloading—reactivates pre-existing, ancient fault systems. This provides direct seismic evidence that inherited faults on stagnant-lid planets like Mars can remain mechanically active over billion-year timescales, serving as a primary mechanism for long-term strain release.
本研究分析了InSight探测到的远端火星震S0976a，将其定位在水手号峡谷，并确定其为深部地壳走滑事件。震源机制推断的应力方向表明，在行星冷却、Tharsis载荷和局部侵蚀卸载共同作用的现代应力场下，古老断裂系统发生了重新活动。这为单盖板块行星上继承性断裂在数十亿年尺度上保持活跃并释放应变提供了……

t: Focal mechanism inversion and stress orientation analysis of the InSight seismic event S0976a to determine faulting style and contemporary stress field.

由InSight SEIS地震仪记录的远端火星震S0976a的地震波形数据。

sum: This paper presents a unified framework for seismic velocity model building and editing by combining learned diffusion priors with structurally preconditioned inverse formulations. A diffusion model is trained on high-resolution synthetic velocity models to learn a data-driven prior, which is then utilized via Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models (DDIM) and guided sampling. For localized editing, the prior is integrated with structurally preconditioned Tikhonov inversion. For full model building, a well-matching inverse problem with imaging-based regularization is solved using DDIM-guided methods and Diffusion Posterior Sampling. Synthetic benchmarks and applications to the Viking Graben field dataset demonstrate that this approach recovers sharper interfaces and higher-resolution structures than classical least-squares inversion.

sum: This study investigates the subsurface geometry and sediment thickness of the Gölbaşı Basin in Türkiye, which suffered severe damage during the 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquakes. By integrating 120 microgravity measurements and Spatial Autocorrelation (SPAC) analyses at 20 locations, the authors delineated the basin's low-density alluvial deposits and derived deep shear-wave velocity (Vs) profiles. The basin contains up to 700 m of unconsolidated sediments, causing significant lateral velocity heterogeneity. A neighborhood-based Pearson correlation analysis revealed a very strong positive correlation (r = 0.905) between severe structural damage and sediment thickness, as well as strong correlations with Vs30 and basin-depth proxies (Z2.5). The novelty lies in the quantitative integration of gravity-derived basin geometry and SPAC-derived site parameters to directly explain the spatial distribution of earthquake damage in a key fault-zone basin.

sum: This study investigates the effects of microstructural heterogeneity on elastically accommodated grain-boundary sliding (EAGBS), a potential mechanism for upper-mantle seismic attenuation. Using 2-D finite-element simulations on periodic Voronoi tessellations, the authors compare irregular grain geometries against regular hexagonal benchmarks. They find that increasing grain-size variance alone causes minimal spectral broadening. However, introducing a broad distribution of grain-boundary viscosities significantly suppresses and broadens the Debye-like loss peak into a wide-frequency attenuation background. This suggests that the absence of a distinct EAGBS peak in dry olivine experiments does not rule out the mechanism, as it may be masked within a broad background, with important implications for interpreting upper-mantle seismic attenuation and velocity dispersion.

sum: This study calibrates a local magnitude ($M_L$) scale for Taiwan's seismic network, which integrates both surface and borehole stations. Using over eight million Wood-Anderson amplitudes from 188,109 earthquakes and 873 stations, the authors calculate individual station corrections for every instrument and response-change interval. Validation tests show that these corrections reduce station magnitude dispersion by over 50% and misfit to moment magnitude ($M_w$) by 21%. To address magnitude saturation for large events ($M_L > 5.5$), they introduce an adjusted amplitude magnitude ($M_A$) as a proxy for moment magnitude. This workflow ensures magnitude consistency across evolving network configurations and improves the reliability of catalog magnitudes for large earthquakes.

sum: The paper introduces the Open Wave Library (OWL), an open-source framework designed for local- to exploration-scale seismic wave modeling and full-waveform inversion (FWI). OWL features high-order finite-difference solvers for 2D and 3D isotropic acoustic, isotropic elastic, and general anisotropic elastic media. It incorporates curvilinear meshes, local refinement for topography, and complex-frequency-shifted multi-axial perfectly matched layers (CFS-MPML) for stability. For FWI, OWL supports conventional, correlation, adaptive, and generalized dynamic time warping (GDTW) misfit functions. Adjoint-state gradients are computed using boundary-reconstructed source wavefields. Parallelism is achieved via shot-level, domain decomposition, and OpenMP. The framework's accuracy is verified against spectral-element solutions, and its applicability is demonstrated using synthetic and field datasets. OWL provides an extensible platform for methodological research and reproducible FWI workflows.

Curvilinear meshes and local refinement for topographic free surfaces.
Complex-frequency-shifted multi-axial perfectly matched layers (CFS-MPML) for absorbing boundaries.
Adjoint-state method with boundary-reconstructed source wavefields for gradient computation.
Generalized dynamic time warping (GDTW) for cycle-skipping mitigation.
用于声波、弹性波和各向异性介质中波传播的高阶有限差分法。
用于地形自由表面的曲线网格和局部细化技术。
用于吸收边界的复频移多轴完美匹配层（CFS-MPML）。
利用边界重建源场计算梯度的伴随状态法。
用于缓解周期跳跃的广义动态时间规整（GDTW）方法。

Sensitivity-kernel studies to evaluate different misfit functions.
Synthetic and field data examples demonstrating applicability to heterogeneous, anisotropic, and topographic models.

The library implements high-order finite-difference solvers with curvilinear meshes, CFS-MPML, and parallel computing capabilities (OpenMP, domain decomposition).

sum: This study addresses the decadal-scale acceleration of aseismic slip along the northern Japan Trench prior to the 2011 Mw 9.0 Tohoku-oki earthquake. The authors invert GNSS velocity fields from 1998 to 2009 using a mechanically motivated model where locked regions are confined to historical rupture areas. They find that the transient acceleration can be explained by creep-front propagation that progressively erodes heterogeneously locked asperities. The inferred asperities shrank from occupying 66% of their rupture areas in 1998 to 37% in 2009, indicating substantial expansion of aseismic creep. This shrinkage rate is consistent with fracture-mechanics predictions, suggesting that megathrust locking can evolve significantly over decadal timescales.
本研究探讨了2011年东北地震前日本海沟北部十年尺度无震滑动加速机制。作者利用力学模型反演了1998-2009年GNSS速度场。结果表明，该瞬态加速源于蠕变前缘传播对非均匀锁定闭锁区的渐进侵蚀。闭锁区比例从66%降至37%，表明无震蠕变显著扩张，证实超大逆冲断层锁定可在十年尺度上显著演化。

t: Inversion of GNSS velocity fields using a mechanically motivated model where locked regions are confined to historical rupture areas with evolving effective sizes and process-zone stressing rates.
利用力学模型反演GNSS速度场，锁定区限制在历史破裂区内且其大小随时间演化。
GNSS velocity fields from 1998 to 2009 along the northern Japan Trench, supplemented by repeating-earthquake estimates of slip acceleration.
1998至2009年日本海沟北部的GNSS速度场数据，并辅以重复地震估算的滑动加速数据。
Inferred locked asperities shrank from 66% of their rupture areas in 1998 to 37% in 2009, explaining the observed decadal creep acceleration prior to the Tohoku-oki earthquake.
闭锁区比例从1998年的66%降至2009年的37%，解释了东北地震前的十年尺度蠕变加速。
The model relies on simplifying assumptions regarding locked zone boundaries being strictly confined to historical rupture areas.
模型依赖于将锁定区边界严格限制在历史破裂区内的简化假设。
Demonstrates that decadal-scale pre-seismic geodetic transients can be quantitatively explained by the mechanical erosion and shrinkage of heterogeneously locked asperities.
定量证实了十年尺度震前地表变形可由非均匀锁定闭锁区的力学侵蚀与收缩来解释。

Quantified the shrinkage of locked asperities from 66% to 37% of their rupture areas between 1998 and 2009.
Showed that megathrust locking is highly dynamic and can evolve substantially over decadal timescales prior to giant earthquakes.
证实了日本海沟北部十年尺度的震前蠕变加速可通过非均匀锁定闭锁区的侵蚀来解释。

表明超大逆冲断层的锁定状态具有高度动态性，在巨震前十年尺度上可发生显著演化。
me: Inversion of GNSS velocity fields (1998–2009) using a mechanically motivated model.
Modeling locked regions confined to historical rupture areas with evolving effective sizes and process-zone stressing rates.
Comparison of predicted slip accelerations with repeating-earthquake estimates and fracture-mechanics predictions.

Repeating-earthquake catalogs/estimates used to validate predicted slip accelerations.
1998至2009年间日本海沟北部的GNSS速度场数据。
用于验证预测滑动加速的重复地震编目及估计数据。

Resolution of GNSS data at depth and offshore near the trench is inherently limited.

GNSS数据在深部及靠近海沟的近海区域的分辨率存在固有局限。

sum: This study utilizes wind-generated flexural waves (0.01–0.5 Hz) recorded by a 1000 m DAS fiber-optic cable on Lake Pääjärvi, Finland, to estimate ice thickness and water depth. By measuring phase-velocity dispersion curves along four cable intervals, the authors invert for these physical properties. The ice-thickness estimates align well with field measurements (2%–34% difference), while water-depth estimates capture the increasing depth trend but underestimate bathymetry by 22%–60% due to a lack of low-wavenumber data. The study also highlights that flexural waves refract toward the shore in shallow waters, which must be corrected to avoid velocity estimation bias. This demonstrates DAS's potential for ambient-noise-based cryospheric monitoring.
本研究利用芬兰Pääjärvi湖上1000米光纤DAS系统记录的风成弯曲波（0.01-0.5 Hz），估算冰层厚度和水深。通过测量四个光纤区段的相速度频散曲线，反演了冰-水系统的物理参数。结果显示，冰厚估算与实测值吻合较好（偏差2%-34%）；水深估算虽能反映变深趋势，但由于缺乏低波数数据，低估了2……

t: Phase-velocity dispersion curves of wind-generated flexural waves (0.01–0.5 Hz) recorded by DAS are measured and inverted to estimate ice thickness and water depth.
测量并反演DAS记录的风成弯曲波（0.01-0.5 Hz）的相速度频散曲线，以估算冰层厚度和水深。
Ambient noise recorded along a 1000 m fiber-optic cable on frozen Lake Pääjärvi, Finland, supplemented by field ice-thickness measurements and bathymetry.
芬兰冰封Pääjärvi湖上1000米光纤电缆记录的背景噪声，辅以实地冰厚测量和湖泊地形数据。
Ice thickness estimates differ from field measurements by 2%–34%; water depth estimates capture the deepening trend but underestimate bathymetry by 22%–60% due to limited low-wavenumber resolution.

Water-depth estimates degrade in deeper water due to lack of low wavenumbers, and wave refraction near shores biases apparent velocity measurements.
由于缺乏低波数信息，深水区水深估算变差，且近岸波浪折射会使视速度测量产生偏差。
First application of wind-generated flexural waves on DAS to simultaneously estimate ice thickness and water depth, highlighting shallow-water refraction effects.
首次利用DAS记录的风成弯曲波同时估算冰厚和水深，并揭示了浅水折射效应。

Estimated ice thickness and water depth along a 1000 m fiber-optic cable, comparing results with field measurements and bathymetry.

沿着1000米长的光纤电缆估算了冰层厚度和水深，并将结果与实地测量和湖泊地形进行了对比。
识别并分析了浅水区弯曲波向岸折射的现象及其对速度估算的影响。
me: Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) data acquisition on a frozen lake.
Phase-velocity dispersion curve measurement of low-frequency (0.01–0.5 Hz) flexural waves.
Inversion of dispersion curves for ice thickness and water depth.
Refraction correction for apparent velocities in shallow water.
在冰封湖泊上进行分布式声学传感（DAS）数据采集。
测量低频（0.01-0.5 Hz）弯曲波的相速度频散曲线。

对浅水区视速度进行折射校正。

Field measurements of ice thickness and lake bathymetry data for validation.
芬兰南部Pääjärvi湖上部署的1000米光纤电缆记录的背景噪声数据。
用于验证的冰厚实地测量数据和湖泊地形数据。
li: Water-depth estimates tend to underestimate true bathymetry (by 22%–60%) and become less robust in deeper water due to the lack of low-wavenumber data.

由于缺乏低波数信息，深水区的水深估算变差，且倾向于低估实际地形（低估22%-60%）。
如果未进行妥善校正，近岸处的波浪折射会使视速度测量产生偏差。

The study focuses on estimating ice thickness and water depth of a frozen lake, which is a cryospheric application.

sum: This study utilizes a dense seismic array of 500 nodes at Cape Modern, Utah, to monitor spatiotemporal velocity variations (dv/v) in the shallow subsurface using ambient-noise tomography. To address azimuthal bias from uneven station distribution, the authors implement a Voronoi tessellation-based path resampling strategy. The resulting spatial maps of dv/v reveal lateral heterogeneity in velocity evolution. The observed velocity decreases and gradual recoveries are frequency-dependent (0.5–1.2 s), indicating a shallow origin. Integrating these observations with environmental data identifies seasonal thermoelastic forcing as the primary driver, showing a 90–100-day delay consistent with thermal diffusion. Shorter periods (0.5–0.8 s) show varying recovery rates (60–130 days) that reflect local thermal conductivity differences, while longer periods (0.8–1.2 s) indicate thermal decoupling at depth. This demonstrates the utility of dense arrays for high-resolution environmental seismology.
本研究利用500个密集地震节点，通过微动断层成像监测犹他州浅表速度时空变化。采用Voronoi重采样克服台站偏差。结果显示速度变化（dv/v）具横向非均匀性与频散特征。结合环境数据证实季节性热弹性力为主导，存在90-100天热扩散延迟，且恢复速度差异反映了热传导率不同。该研究展示了密集台阵精细解析浅……

t: Ambient-noise tomography combined with a Voronoi tessellation-based path resampling strategy to mitigate azimuthal bias from heterogeneous station distributions.
结合基于Voronoi图的路径重采样策略的微动断层成像，以减轻台站分布不均带来的方位角偏差。
Continuous seismic data from 500 seismic nodes deployed across 257 locations at Cape Modern, Utah, alongside environmental temperature data.
部署在犹他州Cape Modern的257个位置的500个地震节点的连续地震数据，以及环境温度数据。
Identified seasonal thermoelastic forcing as the dominant driver of dv/v changes (0.6% variation), with a 90-100 day thermal diffusion delay and spatially variable recovery rates (60-130 days).
确定季节性热弹性力是速度变化的主导因素（0.6%变化），存在90-100天延迟，且恢复速率空间可变（60-130天）。
Analysis is restricted to the shallow subsurface due to the high-frequency range (0.5-1.2 s) of the ambient noise.

Spatially resolving heterogeneous subsurface thermoelastic responses and thermal conductivity differences using a dense array with Voronoi-based path resampling.
利用基于Voronoi重采样的密集台阵，空间解析了非均匀的浅表热弹性响应和热传导率差异。

Introduced a Voronoi tessellation-based path resampling strategy to mitigate azimuthal bias from heterogeneous station distributions.
Identified seasonal thermoelastic forcing as the dominant driver of shallow velocity changes, showing a 90-100 day delay.
Resolved spatial variations in thermal recovery rates (60-130 days) at short periods, reflecting local thermal conductivity differences.
利用500个节点的密集地震台阵成功绘制了浅表速度时空变化（dv/v）图。
引入了基于Voronoi图的路径重采样策略，以减轻台站分布不均带来的方位角偏差。
确定季节性热弹性力是浅部速度变化的主导驱动因素，存在90-100天的延迟。
解析了短周期下热恢复速率的空间差异（60-130天），反映了局部热传导率的不同。

Voronoi tessellation-based path resampling to achieve quasi-uniform ray-path coverage.
Spatiotemporal mapping of relative velocity changes (dv/v) at different frequency bands (0.5-1.2 s).
Thermal diffusion modeling to correlate air temperature with velocity variations.

sum: This paper introduces 'uncontacted airborne seismology,' an innovative method that leverages acoustic-seismic coupling from aircraft-generated sounds to image the shallow subsurface of ice sheets. Using a 36-node seismic array in Antarctica, the authors record seismic waves generated by airborne passes and extract their dispersion curves. Through joint inversion of these dispersion patterns, they successfully reconstruct the elastic properties and porosity of the upper ~100 meters of ice, capturing the critical firn-to-ice transition. This non-invasive, rapid, and scalable framework provides a novel way to map near-surface ice structures, offering significant potential for large-scale monitoring of polar ice sheet dynamics and planetary exploration.
本文提出“非接触式航空地震学”，利用飞机声波在冰面转换的地震波探测冰川浅层。研究利用南极36节点地震台阵记录飞机飞越信号并提取频散曲线，通过联合反演重建了浅表约100米内的弹性性质和孔隙度，揭示了积雪-冰川过渡带。该方法为快速、大范围制图极地冰盖浅层结构提供了新框架，对极地冰盖动力学监测和行星探测有……

对36节点台阵记录的飞机声-震耦合波提取频散曲线并进行联合反演。
Seismic waveforms recorded by a 36-node seismic array during aircraft passes over Antarctic ice.
飞机飞越南极冰盖期间，36节点地震台阵记录的地震波形数据。
Reconstructed the elastic properties and porosity of the upper ~100 m of ice, revealing the firn-ice transition.
重建了冰层浅表约100米内的弹性性质和孔隙度，揭示了积雪-冰川过渡带。
Limited depth penetration (upper ~100 m) and dependency on active aircraft overflights.
探测深度有限（浅表约100米），且依赖于飞机主动飞越。

sum: This study utilizes the physics-based earthquake simulator RSQSim to generate synthetic earthquake catalogs for the Eastern San Francisco Bay Area, investigating the effects of fault connectivity and on-fault frictional parameters. By comparing synthetic catalogs with UCERF3 probabilities and paleoseismic data, the authors find that uniform velocity-weakening and strong coseismic weakening yield lower b-values (~1.4), while models with velocity-strengthening patches produce higher b-values (1.5–1.8). Connected faults promote multi-segment ruptures on the Hayward and Calaveras faults. The simulated 30-year rupture probabilities align well with UCERF3 time-independent and time-dependent estimates. However, statistical tests reject the equality of mean recurrence rates between most models and paleoseismic data at Tyson Lagoon, highlighting the need for future work on the full spectrum of fault slip.
本研究利用基于物理的地震模拟器RSQSim生成加州东旧金山湾区的合成地震目录，探讨了断层连通性和断层摩擦参数的影响。通过与UCERF3概率和古地震数据对比，研究发现均匀速度减弱和强同震减弱模型产生的b值较低（~1.4），而包含速度增强斑块的模型b值较高（1.5-1.8）。断层连通促进了海沃德和卡拉维……

t: Physics-based earthquake simulations using RSQSim with varying fault connectivity and on-fault frictional parameters (velocity-weakening, velocity-strengthening, and coseismic weakening).
使用RSQSim进行基于物理的地震模拟，改变断层连通性和断层摩擦参数。
Synthetic earthquake catalogs compared against UCERF3 time-independent/time-dependent rupture probabilities and paleoseismic recurrence interval data from three Bay Area sites.
合成地震目录，并与UCERF3破裂概率及湾区三个地点的古地震复发间隔数据进行对比。

Models without velocity-strengthening yield 30-year probabilities of 22.4-28.9% (Hayward) and 13.3-20.5% (Calaveras), matching UCERF3 bounds, but most reject paleoseismic recurrence rates at Tyson Lagoon.
无速度增强的模型计算出海沃德断层30年概率为22.4-28.9%，卡拉维拉斯为13.3-20.5%，符合UCERF3区间…

sum: This study analyzes the 24 June 2026 Mw 7.6 Venezuela earthquake sequence using W-phase source inversion, InSAR surface deformation modeling, strong-motion data, and backprojection. The results reveal a complex, multifault rupture that initiated on the right-lateral Boconó fault system before propagating onto the offshore San Sebastián fault (SSF). The rupture lasted approximately 70 seconds, which is twice the duration predicted by global scaling laws. Crucially, backprojection and strong-motion data indicate that the rupture along the SSF reached supershear velocities of up to 5.5 km/s. The event successfully released strain accumulated as a slip deficit previously identified by regional GNSS data. This work provides rare observational evidence of a major multifault supershear rupture.

sum: This study presents a regionalized geospatial liquefaction model framework using Bayesian logistic regression (BLR). By leveraging globally trained models as informative priors and updating them with regional data, the framework mitigates regional bias and overfitting. The method is validated using case studies from the 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquake in Türkiye and the 2018 Anchorage earthquake in Alaska. For Türkiye, the BLR model improves accuracy from 0.77 to 0.84 and the F1 score from 0.74 to 0.85. For Alaska, accuracy increases from 0.62 to 0.71 and the F1 score from 0.46 to 0.73. The framework successfully balances global priors and regional likelihoods via covariance scaling, offering a robust, adaptable solution for region-specific liquefaction hazard assessment.

sum: This study demonstrates that the spread of predicted probability mass functions (PMFs) from neural-network phase pickers, specifically the interquartile range (IQR), serves as a robust, data-driven indicator of phase-pick confidence. Using the Pacific Northwest Seismic Network dataset, the authors show that PMF spread tracks picking difficulty even when models are trained on simple one-hot labels without explicit quality information. Label-perturbation experiments reveal that predictive distributions inherit systematic bias and label variability from training targets. Furthermore, PMF IQR correlates more consistently with analyst-assigned quality tiers than traditional metrics like signal-to-noise ratio or magnitude-distance. This approach provides a reproducible, automated confidence metric for seismic monitoring and catalog construction.

sum: This paper presents a novel workflow for high-resolution near-surface characterization using localized anthropogenic seismic signals, specifically human footsteps, recorded by Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS). To overcome reliance on active sources or ideal ambient noise, the authors integrate an object detection algorithm to automatically identify and extract footstep signals from continuous DAS data. They apply multichannel analysis of surface waves (MASW) on subarrays to extract and stack dispersion spectra, obtaining fundamental-mode surface-wave dispersion curves. These curves are inverted to reconstruct the near-surface shear-wave velocity structure. The workflow is validated using field data, showing velocity variations consistent with local geological conditions. This approach offers a cost-effective, environmentally adaptive imaging solution for complex near-surface environments.

sum: This study investigates the preservation of ancient continental lithospheric mantle within massive translithospheric fault systems. While cratonic lithospheric roots are often modified or decratonized during tectonic events, the authors show that relict ancient mantle domains can survive within major fault zones. This has significant implications for understanding lithospheric evolution, mantle heterogeneity, and the role of deep-seated fault systems in channeling fluids and preserving ancient geological signatures.

sum: This paper establishes a three-equation theoretical framework (thermodynamic, kinematic, and dynamic paths) to determine the characteristic timescale of plate tectonics and asthenospheric circulation. It proposes that the dry peridotite solidus (~1300°C) acts as a thermodynamic anchor. By incorporating mantle heat flux, lithospheric confining pressure, and trench-ridge distances, the three paths converge on a characteristic timescale of 260–285 Myr (centered at ~280 Myr). Standard dynamic and kinematic estimates (222–233.6 Myr) are shown to be lower bounds. The model successfully explains plate-specific circulation times (e.g., Pacific, Nazca) and suggests that minor temperature adjustments (20–50 K) in the asthenosphere can regulate circulation times toward the statistical center, providing a negative-feedback mechanism for plate tectonics.

sum: This paper presents a stochastic sampling-filtering framework to address the non-uniqueness of reconstructing paleo-earthquake ruptures from sparse geological and chronological observations. By representing rupture scenarios as an ensemble constrained by geological, chronological, and mapped fault data, the framework samples candidate ruptures in timing, center position, and length, retaining only those satisfying the constraints. Applied to the Yanzhi Shan Fault, the method successfully identifies eight rupture-age density modes and a persistent southeastward spatial density trend. Prior-sensitivity tests demonstrate that the filtering process reduces differences between ensembles generated from contrasting priors, indicating constraint-induced convergence. This framework provides a robust tool for extracting observation-supported statistical rupture patterns while preserving and quantifying the inherent uncertainties in paleo-earthquake timing and geometry.
本文提出随机采样-过滤框架，解决利用稀疏地质观测重建古地震破裂的非唯一性。该方法将破裂情景表示为受约束的系综，对破裂时间、位置和长度进行采样筛选。应用于胭脂山断裂带，识别出8个破裂年龄密度模式及向东南的破裂趋势。先验敏感性测试表明过滤能减少先验差异，实现约束引导的收敛，有效量化了不确定性。

sum: This paper addresses a key limitation in tsunami source modeling: the classical Kajiura filter assumes a uniform ocean depth, whereas real earthquake sources span complex bathymetry like trenches and slopes. The author derives an exact transfer operator (C = B^-1) for arbitrary, smooth, 3D bathymetry. This formulation incorporates bottom-normal forcing and slope effects directly into the boundary conditions, capturing global coupling. Synthetic tests on wedges and seamounts, along with an application to the 2011 Tohoku-Oki earthquake, demonstrate that local water depth controls primary attenuation, while slopes and surrounding geometry introduce phase corrections and nonlocal redistribution. Crucially, the new operator ensures global volume consistency and unifies rapid-source initialization with time-dependent tsunami generation.

sum: This paper proposes a novel model to explain the long-lasting, spindle-shaped lunar seismic coda using random vacuum fractures in the lunar crust. Unlike traditional continuous-medium models with strong velocity contrasts, this model treats vacuum fractures as insulating boundaries that cause strong, persistent reverberation via total reflection. Numerical simulations demonstrate that a limited number of simplified fractures in a homogeneous matrix can reproduce Apollo seismic observations with envelope correlations exceeding 0.9. The results suggest that fractures in the uppermost ~1 km of the lunar crust dominate seismic scattering. This model provides a new framework to study the shallow lunar fracture system and suppress coda waves to image deep lunar interiors.

sum: This study analyzes the aftershock sequence of the 2022 M6.8 Luding earthquake in China to investigate tidal modulation. By examining the temporal correlation between Earth tides and aftershock occurrences, the authors identify a significant tidal triggering effect. This modulation is highly correlated with fluid migration and pore pressure changes within the fault zone following the mainshock. The findings provide critical observational evidence for fluid-fault interactions and their influence on post-seismic stress relaxation and aftershock triggering mechanisms.

sum: This study investigates the physical drivers of transformational faulting, a key candidate mechanism for deep-focus earthquakes, by focusing on the quartz-coesite phase transition in novaculite. Through high-pressure deformation experiments, the authors test whether a large volume change alone can trigger instability. Under sluggish reaction kinetics, they observe acoustic emissions and microstructural evidence of strain localization and faulting, characterized by a b-value of ~1. In contrast, fast reaction kinetics lead to distributed deformation and fewer, smaller events (b-value ~3). This provides the first experimental evidence of transformational faulting during the quartz-coesite transition, demonstrating that volume change is a primary driver of high-pressure brittle failure. This expands the range of mineral transitions capable of generating intermediate and deep earthquakes.
本研究通过对黑硅石在石英-柯石英相变过程中的高压变形实验，探讨了深源地震触发机制——相变断裂的物理驱动力。实验结果表明，在缓慢的反应动力学条件下，声发射和微观结构显示出明显的应变局部化和断层面形成，b值约为1；而在快速动力学条件下，变形呈弥散状且伴随较少、较小震级的事件（b值约为3）。这是首次在石英……

t: High-pressure deformation experiments on novaculite during the quartz-coesite transition, combined with acoustic emission monitoring and post-mortem microstructural analysis.
在石英-柯石英相变期间对黑硅石进行高压变形实验，并结合声发射监测和微观结构分析。

Sluggish kinetics led to strain localization, faulting, and b-values of ~1, while fast kinetics resulted in distributed deformation and b-values of ~3, proving volume change drives high-pressure failure.

The study focuses on the quartz-coesite transition rather than mantle olivine transitions, and laboratory strain rates differ significantly from nature.
研究侧重于石英-柯石英相变而非地幔橄榄石相变，且实验室应变速率与自然界差异显著。
First experimental demonstration of transformational faulting during the quartz-coesite transition, isolating volume change as a sufficient driver for high-pressure brittle failure.
首次实验证实石英-柯石英相变中的相变断裂，孤立出体积变化作为高压脆性破裂的充分驱动力。

kc: Provides the first experimental evidence of transformational faulting during the quartz-coesite phase transition.
Demonstrates that a large volume change alone, without requiring thermal runaway or mechanical contrast, can drive strain localization and brittle failure.
Identifies two distinct deformation regimes (localized vs. distributed) controlled by reaction kinetics, reflected in b-values of ~1 and ~3.
首次提供了石英-柯石英相变过程中相变断裂的实验证据。
证明了仅凭巨大的体积变化（无需热失控或机械强度对比）即可驱动应变局部化和脆性破裂。
发现了受反应动力学控制的两种不同变形机制（局部化与弥散式），分别对应~1和~3的b值。
me: High-pressure and high-temperature deformation experiments on novaculite samples.
Monitoring of acoustic emissions (AEs) to detect microfracturing and estimate b-values.
Microstructural analysis of run products to observe strain localization and fault plane formation.
对黑硅石样品进行高压高温变形实验。
监测声发射（AE）信号以检测微破裂并估算b值。
对实验产物进行微观结构分析，以观察应变局部化和断层面的形成。
de: Deformation experiments on novaculite during the quartz-to-coesite transition under varying reaction kinetics.
Acoustic emission catalogs recording event rates and magnitudes.
在不同反应动力学条件下，黑硅石在石英-柯石英相变期间的变形实验。
记录事件频率和震级的声发射（AE）目录。
li: The experiments are conducted on quartz-coesite, which is representative of crustal/subducted felsic rocks rather than mantle olivine-spinel transitions.
Extrapolating laboratory reaction kinetics and strain rates to geological timescales remains challenging.
实验针对石英-柯石英相变，这代表地壳/俯冲长英质岩石，而非地幔中的橄榄石-尖晶石相变。
将实验室的反应动力学和应变速率外推至地质时间尺度仍具有挑战性。

tm.why: The paper investigates transformational faulting as a triggering mechanism for deep-focus earthquakes.
It explores strain localization, fault plane formation, and brittle failure under high pressure.
